notes.title: Hades II v1.0 Is Now Available!
notes.content:
We couldn't possibly be more excited to announce that we've completed the Early Access development of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i], and officially launched v1.0 of the game!! Whether you've been playing all through Early Access or this will be your very first foray into our take on the Underworld of Greek myth, we welcome you and thank you for joining us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/
[h2]About the v1.0 Launch Update[/h2]
Those who've been keeping up with our Early Access development can look forward to a slew of exciting additions in our v1.0 Launch Update, notably the true ending of the story, scores of new events for the game's dozens of fully voiced characters, new music we can't wait for you to hear, new Fated List prophecies, new late-game unlockables, and more! 

And of course, we've finally added [b]Achievements[/b] along with other finishing touches! If you've been playing in Early Access, you may earn many Achievements retroactively, and won't need to start over to earn any of the remaining ones. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1145350/view/512967793587520047]Full patch notes are here[/url].

[h2]About the Hades II Original Soundtrack[/h2]
The completion of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] also marks the completion of the [b]Hades II Original Soundtrack[/b] by our award-winning composer Darren Korb. Much like the game itself, this is our biggest-ever soundtrack, clocking in at just under four hours of music created for this game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950840/Hades_II_Original_Soundtrack/
If you've been enjoying the soundtrack already, know that we've saved some of the best for last! The soundtrack is available here on Steam or free streaming on [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL53mjgVKFq7yeq21XhibC8izNSVlPCsNP]our YouTube channel[/url] or other services.

[h2]About the Game[/h2]
[i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] is a rogue-like dungeon crawler in which you'll battle beyond the Underworld of Greek myth using dark sorcery to take on the sinister Titan of Time. Our studio's first-ever sequel builds on the best aspects of the award-winning original in an all-new, action-packed, endlessly replayable experience rooted in the Underworld of Greek myth and its deep connections to the dawn of witchcraft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/d12cbc61b6c238129d58e5bb9f5abca4c962b31f.jpg[/img]
As the immortal Princess of the Underworld, you'll explore a bigger, deeper mythic world, vanquishing the forces of the Titan of Time with the full might of Olympus behind you, in a sweeping story that continually unfolds through your every setback and accomplishment. New locations, challenges, upgrade systems, and surprises await as you delve into the ever-shifting Underworld again and again. For more information, check the [url=https://www.supergiantgames.com/blog/hades2-faq]Hades II FAQ[/url] on our website.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
We've given v1.0 of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] everything we've got! As with any of our Major Updates, we'll be keeping a close eye on this launch to ensure it's as problem-free as possible, and deploy hotfixes or patches in case of any issues. Beyond that, it's too early to say what's next for our team! We'll likely take some time to reflect and recharge.

[h2]Thank You for Playing!![/h2]
While [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] spent more than four-and-a-half years in development, including about a year and a half in Early Access, it's also the culmination of all the experience we've gained together as a team since Supergiant Games started back in 2009. Early Access development was foundational to the entire idea of the original [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], and proved instrumental to this latest game as well. So, from all of us, thank you for inspiring us to do our best, and we hope you enjoy your time with [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i]. [i]May moonlight guide you![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/ce5be91be62f87e7de6848a99d7e1f03c170b4e2.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.0 Launch Update - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/830489f1dede5be95788de610d80ef37a20686e4.png[/img]
The [b]v1.0 Launch[/b] of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] has finally arrived! The true ending awaits, along with Achievements and many other finishing touches we hope you'll enjoy. While this update marks the conclusion of our [b]Early Access[/b] development, we will be monitoring this launch closely and patching any issues that arise. To all our [b]Early Access[/b] players, thank you so much! We hope you enjoy the complete game.

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
• [b]The True Ending[/b]: discover what awaits Princess Melinoë at the end of her journey
• [b]Achievements[/b]: earn 50 different Achievements as you play through the game
• [b]Familiar Forms[/b]: give your favorite Familiar a makeover with new unlockable visual styles
• [b]New Keepsakes[/b]: several new Keepsakes are waiting to be discovered... but from whom?
• [b]New Decorations[/b]: liven up the Crossroads with new unlockable decor
• [b]New Artwork[/b]: new visual effects, environment art, and other visual improvements abound
• [b]New Music[/b]: listen for a number of stirring new tracks
• [b]And More[/b]: we'll leave the rest for you to discover... 

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
• Added 50 [b]Achievements[/b]! Note you do not need to start the game over to earn any Achievement; you may earn certain Achievements retroactively once you load your saved progress

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
· [b]Sister Blades[/b]: increased damage and range of Attack sequence
· [b]Umbral Flames[/b]: reduced Special damage
· [b]Moonstone Axe[/b]: increased Special speed; now easier to Dash out of the Attack sequence
· [b]Argent Skull[/b]: Omega Special channels faster

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [b]Moonstone Axe (Melinoë)[/b]: increased bonus Attack Power and Max Life
· [b]Moonstone Axe (Thanatos)[/b]: increased Critical chance of Mortality effect; re-scaled Attack speed bonuses from upgrades
· [b]Argent Skull (Medea)[/b]: fixed an issue causing the damage bonus to affect Casts, which was not intended
· [spoiler]Sister Blades (Morrigan)[/spoiler]: fixed Specials not hitting repeatedly as expected
· [spoiler]Umbral Flames (Supay)[/spoiler]: reduced Omega Special Magick cost and damage; slightly reduced Omega Attack and Omega Special rate of fire
· Minor adjustments to requirements for Hidden Aspects to be revealed to Melinoë by various characters

[h1]Altar of Ashes[/h1]
· Adjusted upgrade costs of various Arcana Cards

[h1]Oath of the Unseen[/h1]
📢 The stasis effect from the [b]Stopper[/b] Perk from the [b]Vow of Fangs[/b] now is easier to anticipate
· Increased effectiveness of [b]Drainer[/b] and [b]Shielder[/b] Perks from the [b]Vow of Fangs[/b]
· Unlocking the final rank of [b]Vow of Rivals[/b] now requires having reached the True Ending
· Increased Fear requirement for claiming rewards from [b]Bounties of the Infinite Abyss (Cauldron)[/b]

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· [b]Nexus Rush (Hera)[/b]: now affects surrounding foes instead of only on contact
· [b]Extended Family (Hera)[/b]: fixed Boons of Hades counting toward the bonus [i](he is not an Olympian)[/i]
· [b]Poseidon[/b]: Splash effects should activate more reliably with strikes of varying speed and strength
· [b]Wave Flourish (Poseidon)[/b]: reduced bonus from Rarity to compensate for the previous change
· [b]Nova Strike (Apollo)[/b]: increased area with Sister Blades and Umbral Flames
· [b]Nova Flourish (Apollo)[/b]: increased area with Sister Blades and Black Coat
· [b]Lucid Gain (Apollo)[/b]: no longer requires you to stand in your Cast, but now restores less Magick
· [b]Exceptional Talent (Apollo)[/b]: increased Magick cost; fixed the effect with certain abilities
· [b]Wispy Wiles (Aphrodite)[/b]: reduced Dodge chance
· [b]Furnace Blast (Hephaestus)[/b]: fixed Heroic rarity and bonuses from [b]Poms of Power[/b]
· [b]Snuffed Candle (Hestia)[/b]: fixed an issue limiting the damage bonus only to Attacks and Specials
· [b]Grisly Gain (Ares)[/b]: increased Magick restoration; improved bonus from [b]Poms of Power[/b]
· [b]Mean Streak (Hermes)[/b]: now only affects Attacks and Specials
· [b]Phalanx Shot (Athena)[/b]: reduced projectile speed, letting each shot Deflect for a longer duration
· [b]Lapis Lazuli Insight (Circe)[/b]: now upgrades an additional Arcana Card
· [b]Life Tax (Hades)[/b]: increased total Life restored
· [b]Gigaros Dash (Hades)[/b]: reduced direct damage
· [b]Unseen Ire (Hades)[/b]: reduced bonus damage
· [b]Ripple Effect (Hera x Poseidon)[/b]: reduced effect chance
· [b]Beach Ball (Poseidon x Apollo)[/b]: increased projectile speed; it keeps up better if Melinoë is very fast
· [b]Hearty Appetite (Demeter x Aphrodite)[/b]: now only affects Attacks and Specials
· Further clarifications to descriptions for various Boons
· Various other minor fixes and adjustments

[h1]Hexes & Path of Stars[/h1]
· Adjusted placement of several upgrades on the various Paths
· [b]Dark Side[/b]: reduced Attack and Special damage
· [b]Resonance (Dark Side)[/b]: now correctly applies any damage bonuses from your Attack

· [b]Rigor (Night Bloom)[/b]: fixed an issue causing the bonus from this to apply twice

[h1]Keepsakes[/h1]

· [b]Harpy Talon (Thessaly)[/b]: increased move speed, attack speed, and attack distance
· [b]Auto-Seeker (Olympus)[/b]: increased time before firing; increased damage; other minor changes

· [spoiler]Tail of Typhon (Summit)[/spoiler]: reduced bomb blast range

[h1]Special Encounters[/h1]

notes.title: Early Access Patch 11 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/e2b081233badac839b2f53435e834b9ae386b531.png[/img]
While we said our prior patch would [i]likely[/i] be our last before our [b]v1.0[/b] launch, as the Fates would have it, there is indeed this one more, which includes further improvements, balance adjustments, and fixes based on your feedback and what we've observed. Thank you for playing in [b]Early Access[/b]!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
· [b]Notice:[/b] In preparation for our [b]v1.0[/b] launch and forthcoming story sequences surrounding the True Ending, please note that any [b]Zodiac Sand[/b] or [b]Void Lens[/b] resources you have when you load your save progress at that time will automatically be converted to [b]Prestige[/b]. For now, you may continue earning these if you wish.

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
· [b]Umbral Flames[/b]: increased Special projectile size and orbit speed
· [b]Moonstone Axe[/b]: increased damage of Attack sequence
· [b]Black Coat[/b]: improved responsiveness of blocking while channeling Omega Attack

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [b]Sister Blades (Artemis)[/b]: reduced recharge time for Riposte effect, so it can be used more frequently
· [b]Umbral Flames (Melinoë)[/b]: increased Critical damage chance
· [b]Umbral Flames (Eos)[/b]: using Special no longer cancels other Special projectiles; improved target tracking of Daybreaker projectile
· [b]Moonstone Axe (Thanatos)[/b]: increased Critical chance ramp-up and upper limit
· [spoiler]Witch's Staff (Anubis)[/spoiler]: increased Magick cost of Omega Special
· [spoiler]Umbral Flames (Supay)[/spoiler]: reworked Special creates a second projectile; reworked Attack timings and Omega Attack; shots no longer stagger foes; reduced Rush Boon damage bonus; breaks Urns more easily
· [spoiler]Black Coat (Shiva)[/spoiler]: reworked Omega Special bounces several times in the target area; reduced Destructive damage bonus to compensate

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· [b]Storm Ring (Zeus)[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Arc Flash (Zeus)[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Tidal Ring (Poseidon)[/b]: reduced damage
· [b]High Surf (Poseidon)[/b]: reduced area of effect
· [b]Solar Ring (Apollo)[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Hephaestus[/b]: increased damage of Blast effects, such as [b]Smithy Rush[/b]; increased Glow bonus from Rarity
· [b]Tough Gain (Hephaestus)[/b]: effect now activates even if you are protected by [b]Paid Dues (Hermes)[/b]
· [b]Molten Touch (Hephaestus)[/b]: increased damage to Armor, increased bonus from [b]Poms of Power[/b]
· [b]Heat Rush (Hestia)[/b]: slightly reduced duration of damage trail
· [b]Ares[/b]: Plasma can no longer grant more than +100% move and strike speed, which caused various issues
· [b]Golden Rule (Hera x Poseidon)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Ripple Effect (Hera x Poseidon)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your effects from [b]Fine Line (Hera)[/b] and [b]Ocean Swell (Poseidon)[/b] have a chance to fire twice
· [b]Seismic Hammer (Poseidon x Hephaestus)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Seismic Servo (Poseidon x Hephaestus)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Any Boon effects that recharge over time recharge faster
· [b]Room Temperature (Demeter x Hephaestus)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Cryo Pounder (Demeter x Hephaestus)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your blasts from Hephaestus deal more damage to Freeze-afflicted foes
· [b]Rude Awakening (Apollo x Hephaestus)[/b]: increased bonus damage
· [b]Chain Reaction (Hephaestus x Hestia)[/b]: increased timing window of Double Blast effect
· [b]Travel Deal (Hermes)[/b]: reduced Gold discount
· [b]Harm for the Afflicted (Medea)[/b]: increased how frequently this can deal damage
· [b]Suffering on Sight (Medea)[/b]: increased average damage
· [b]Old Herbal Remedy (Circe)[/b]: fixed an issue causing this effect to not be reduced by [b]Vow of Scars (Oath)[/b]
· [b]Protective Coating (Icarus)[/b]: increased Armor
· [b]Volatile Coating (Icarus)[/b]: increased Armor and blast damage

[h1]Daedalus Hammer Upgrades[/h1]
· [b]Inverted Spark (Flames)[/b]: improved compatibility with more Aspects
· [spoiler]Helheim Charge (Skull)[/spoiler]: now fires your Omega Attack an additional time in succession
· [spoiler]Chakra Collider (Coat)[/spoiler]: increased Power Shot timing window
· [spoiler]Awakened Rockets (Coat)[/spoiler]: increased Magick cost

[h1]Hexes & Path of Stars[/h1]
📢 Reduced start-up time of most Hexes, making them faster to use
📢 [b]Godsent[/b] upgrades now can appear on subsequent uses of the Path of Stars, if you meet the required Olympian after prior uses
· [b]Confluence (Night Bloom)[/b]: now makes your raised servants appear in your Casts, not after you Sprint
📢 Improved menu navigation of the Path of Stars while using gamepad controls

[h1]Keepsakes[/h1]
📢 Olympian Keepsakes such as [b]Cloud Bangle (Zeus)[/b] activate more reliably in [b]Thessaly[/b]
· [b]Ghost Onion[/b]: restorative effect is no longer reduced by [b]Vow of Scars (Oath)[/b]
· [b]Crystal Figurine[/b]: now activates an additional random Arcana Card

[h1]Animal Familiars[/h1]
· [b]Toula the Cat[/b]: improved bonuses from Familiar Bonds, and innate movement speed, pounce accuracy, and active time between naps; she is also less prone to getting stuck on obstacles
· Removed [b]Attending a Faithful Beast (Cauldron)[/b] , along with associated bonuses from Resting your Familiars

[h1]Foes & Dangers[/h1]
· Encounters on [b]Olympus[/b] now have slightly fewer foes
· Encounters with [b]Icarus[/b] have slightly fewer foes at the same time
· Encounters on the [b]Summit[/b] now have slightly fewer foes; some smaller foes have slightly increased Life
· Foes from [b]Moon Monuments[/b] now have more Armor in later Regions
· [spoiler]Typhon[/spoiler]: reduced speed and damage of main eye blast; reduced duration of some projectiles; reduced frequency of cyclone attacks in second phase
· [b]Prometheus[/b]: reduced tracking speed of uppercut
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Cerberus[/spoiler]: no longer also drops magma on top of his attacks
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Scylla[/spoiler]: the guest artist fires fewer projectiles than before
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Hecate[/spoiler]: fixed an issue causing the real [spoiler]Hecate[/spoiler] to be easier to distinguish from the other two, unlike in the standard Encounter
· [spoiler]Master-Slicer (Erebus)[/spoiler]: reduced Life
· [b]Lurker (Oceanus)[/b]: attacks can be blocked more reliably using the [b]Black Coat[/b]
· [b]Shellback (Oceanus)[/b]: Elite now shoots a larger bouncing projectile instead of a triple-shot
· [b]Holeheart (Fields)[/b]: thrown bomb no longer deals direct damage; Elite no longer throws multiples at once
· [b]Brush-Stalker (Fields)[/b]: reduced maximum targeting distance for ranged attack
· [b]Lycaon (Fields)[/b]: pounce attack now is slower to start
· [b]Goldwraith (Tartarus)[/b]: slightly reduced appearance rate
· [b]Tempus (Tartarus)[/b]: slightly reduced appearance rate
· [b]Sandskull (Tartarus)[/b]: slightly reduced appearance rate
· [b]Satyr Hoplite (Olympus)[/b] : Elite throws fewer projectiles at once
· [b]Satyr Vierophant (Tartarus)[/b]: adjusted summoning behavior; reduced duration of fireball and its damage trail
· [b]Shambler[/b]: all varieties have reduced tracking speed
· [b]Bronzebeak (Ephyra)[/b]: adjusted attack behavior
· [b]Lubber (Ephyra)[/b]: fixed an issue causing their flames to sometimes destroy your projectiles
· [b]Eidolon (Ephyra)[/b]: Elite no longer throws multiple projectiles at once
· [b]Droplet (Thessaly)[/b] : reduced move speed
· [b]Stickler (Thessaly)[/b] : reduced projectile speed
· [b]Boozer (Thessaly)[/b] : reduced lunge-attack distance and accuracy
· [b]Harpy Talon (Thessaly)[/b] : removed cyclone attack
· [b]Auto-Seeker (Olympus)[/b] : removed self-destruct attack; reduced number of shots but increased damage
· [b]Auto-Forcer (Olympus)[/b] : reduced move speed during whirlwind attack; increased recovery time
· [b]Sky-Dracon (Olympus)[/b] : removed flame-breath attack
· [b]Mega-Dracon (Olympus)[/b] : updated flame-breath attack
· [b]Satyr Goldpike (Olympus)[/b] : Elite throws fewer projectiles at once
· [b]Satyr Sapper (Olympus)[/b] : reduced speed and range of rocket attack; Elite fires fewer rockets

[h1]Level Design & Environments[/h1]
· Several Locations on [b]Olympus[/b] now have more places to take cover against enemy fire
· Improved pathing and collision in several Locations

[h1]Book of Shadows[/h1]
📢 Improved sorting of Path of Stars upgrades for [b]Selene[/b] after the Incantation [b]Insight Into Offerings[/b]

[h1]Art & Visual FX[/h1]
· Further adjustments to visual FX of various strikes and abilities to improve visual clarity in combat
· Other minor fixes and improvements

[h1]Voice & Narrative[/h1]
· Updated voiceover for [b]Athena[/b]

[h1]Music & SFX[/h1]
· Improved audio feedback for Power Shot effects
· Updated sound effects for [spoiler]Umbral Flames (Supay)[/spoiler]
· Other minor improvements

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
📢 You can no longer lose all your Life in the brief time it takes [b]Athena[/b] to arrive once she is on her way
📢 You can no longer lose all your Life between clearing a Chaos Trial and being sent back by [b]Chaos[/b]
📢 Your raised servants now show damage numbers when their strikes connect
📢 You can no longer Deflect raised [b]Tempii[/b] attempting to heal you in the Encounter against [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler]
📢 Improved feedback on some Boons or items whose Life restoration is reduced by [b]Vow of Scars[/b]
· Clarified that [b]Gift Gift Gift (Echo)[/b] requires switching Keepsakes to take effect
· Updated [b]Credits[/b] with additional contributors
· Updates and fixes to translations in some languages

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
· Fixed an issue causing the Rush Boon bonus from [spoiler]Umbral Flames (Supay)[/spoiler] to affect indirect Boons such as [b]Beach Ball (Poseidon x Apollo)[/b]
· Fixed an issue causing Blast effects from [b]Hephaestus[/b] to gain 'strike foes from behind' bonuses
📢 Fixed [b]Ionic Gain (Zeus)[/b] Aether Fonts appearing in unreachable places in the [spoiler]Unrivaled Eris[/spoiler] Encounter
📢 Fixed [b]Blinding Rush (Apollo)[/b] or other Daze effects not affecting [spoiler]Typhon[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed interaction with various Aspects and [b]Exceptional Talent (Apollo)[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Buried Treasure (Poseidon)[/b] or [b]Quick Buck (Hermes)[/b] items sometimes being out of reach
📢 Fixed [b]Whispered Prayer (Artemis)[/b] not improving with Rarity
📢 Fixed interactions with [spoiler]Witch's Staff (Anubis)[/spoiler] and [b]Wave Strike (Poseidon)[/b] or [b]Cardio Gain (Hestia)[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Purification (Phase Shift)[/b] destroying your projectiles from [spoiler]Black Coat (Shiva)[/spoiler]
· Fixed [b]Gigaros Dash (Hades)[/b] amplifying damage other than Attack and Special
📢 Fixed [spoiler]Full Service (Icarus)[/spoiler] not improving [b]Rapid Slash (Daedalus - Axe)[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Mega Blaze (Daedalus - Flames)[/b] not affecting Omega Attack as described
📢 Fixed [spoiler]Garmr Gaze (Daedalus - Skull)[/spoiler] reducing range unexpectedly
📢 Fixed [b]Ambition (Sky Fall)[/b] not working against Guardians as described
📢 Fixed a rare case where [spoiler]Typhon[/spoiler] could remain impervious indefinitely...
📢 Fixed [spoiler]Unrivaled Scylla[/spoiler] sometimes stage-diving into the walls and getting stuck...
📢 Fixed [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler] sometimes speaking over the Pause Menu even while absent in the [spoiler]Typhon[/spoiler] Encounter
· Fixed various issues with foes summoned by [spoiler]Typhon[/spoiler]
· Fixed several cases where Olympian effects could appear on impervious foes
· Fixed [b]Voice of Truth[/b] Prophecy missing a requirement for [b]Gold Gold Gold (Echo)[/b]
· Fixed text not fading out as expected during the narrated [b]Homer[/b] outcomes after a successful clear
📢 Fixed various voice lines and story events playing unexpectedly or not playing when expected
📢 Fixed occasional visual issues with Magick Indicator while using [b]Black Coat (Nyx)[/b]
📢 Fixed several text errors
· Other minor fixes

[h1]Quote of the Patch[/h1]
[i]'Thirsty for water, \[Narcissus\] started to drink, but soon grew thirsty for something else. His being was suddenly overwhelmed by a vision of beauty. He fell in love with an empty hope, a shadow mistaken for substance.'[/i]

[b]~Metamorphoses[/b] (Ovid; D. Raeburn translation)

notes.title: Early Access Patch 10 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/281cfa412118453a27232683c7d002a84e62546b.png[/img]
Thank you for playing our recent [b]Unseen Update[/b]! This patch makes a number of adjustments to some of the latest additions. We'll keep monitoring your feedback, though this will likely be our final patch before our [b]v1.0[/b] launch, whenever that will be! We're very grateful for your support throughout [b]Early Access[/b]!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
· Reduced further cases of successive attacks causing you to become 'stun-locked'
· Whenever you take damage to Armor, it will reduce any temporary Armor you have from sources such as [b]Security System (Hephaestus)[/b], prior to reducing the more-permanent kind

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
· [b]Sister Blades[/b]: Omega Attack can no longer be interrupted by foes
· [b]Umbral Flames[/b]: reduced orbit speed of Omega Special projectiles, but increased their damage
· [b]Argent Skull[/b]: Omega Special wave projectiles no longer stagger foes
· [b]Black Coat[/b]: increased speed of Attack sequence and damage of first strike; slightly increased Omega Attack channel speed, and it can block more types of incoming area-effect damage; increased Special accuracy

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [b]Witch's Staff (Melinoë)[/b]: reduced bonus to Magick and Power
· [b]Witch's Staff (Momus)[/b]: slightly increased how long it takes your serpents to fire successive Omega Moves
· [b]Sister Blades (Pan)[/b]: it now is easier to Dash out of recovery times
· [spoiler]Sister Blades (Morrigan)[/spoiler]: improved input buffering, reducing cases of dropped inputs during combat
· [b]Umbral Flames (Moros)[/b]: adjusted projectile speeds; aligned Omega Attack damage with base Aspect
· [spoiler]Umbral Flames (Supay)[/spoiler]: reduced projectiles from Attacks and Specials, but increased their damage; reduced Rush Boon damage bonus
· [spoiler]Moonstone Axe (Nergal)[/spoiler]: slightly reduced Dash-Strike damage; slightly increased Attack damage
· [b]Argent Skull (Medea)[/b]: slightly reduced area of Attacks, which still is greater than the base Aspect
· [b]Argent Skull (Persephone)[/b]: fixed an issue causing Boons to gain bonus Lv. more often than intended
· [spoiler]Argent Skull (Hel)[/spoiler]: now breaks Urns more easily
· [b]Black Coat (Nyx)[/b]: increased Omega Boost damage; increased damage of Special Nightspawns
· [spoiler]Black Coat (Shiva)[/spoiler]: reworked Destructive effect now makes Omega Attack deal bonus damage; increased Special damage; normalized Omega Special travel time, reticle remains until the blast

[h1]Oath of the Unseen[/h1]
· [b]Vow of Frenzy[/b]: now also makes foes enter the battle faster; reduced effect on [b]Vow of Rivals[/b] moves
· [b]Vow of Scars[/b]: fixed several cases where this was not reducing Life recovery as expected

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· [b]Steady Growth (Demeter)[/b]: now will only Rarify itself if you have no other eligible Boons
· [b]Hestia[/b]: Scorch Curse can no longer deal Critical damage or similar, nor is affected by [b]Air Quality (Zeus)[/b]
· [b]Flame Strike (Hestia)[/b]: slightly reduced Scorch damage
· [b]Flame Flourish (Hestia)[/b]: slightly reduced Scorch damage
· [b]Success Rate (Hermes)[/b]: no longer affects the passive effect of [b]Raki[/b]
· [b]Incandescent Aura (Hera x Hestia)[/b]: reworked — now deals damage to all Hitch-afflicted foes when you restore Magick
· [b]Natural Selection (Poseidon x Demeter)[/b]: reworked — now distributes bonus Lv. to your primary Boons
· [b]Scalding Vapor (Poseidon x Hestia)[/b]: no longer can activate the Froth Curse
· [b]Gigaros Dash (Hades)[/b]: reduced damage; fixed Scorn amplifying damage other than Attack and Special
· [b]Unseen Ire (Hades)[/b]: fixed an issue causing the effect duration to last longer than stated
· [b]Crimson Dress (Arachne)[/b]: fixed an issue causing this to give a high damage bonus right away; increased bonus per Encounter

[h1]Daedalus Hammer Upgrades[/h1]
· [b]Boosted Ignition (Skull)[/b]: no longer offered while using [spoiler]Aspect of Hel[/spoiler]
· [b]Looming Ignition (Skull)[/b]: fixed an issue causing this to give its full damage bonus immediately rather than over the duration as described
· [spoiler]Pharaoh Etchings (Staff)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Lone Shades deal more damage and automatically launch at foes struck by your Omega Special
· [spoiler]Sinister Pinion (Blades)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Your Specials repeatedly deal damage faster
· [spoiler]Helheim Charge (Skull)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Your Omega Attack fires twice in succession
· [spoiler]Chakra Collider (Coat)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Your Omega Attack gains a Power Shot that deals heavy damage

[h1]Hexes & Path of Stars[/h1]
📢 Adjusted [b]Path of Stars[/b] layouts to make room especially for [b]Godsent[/b] upgrades
· Adjusted when [b]Godsent[/b] upgrades are offered during the story for the first time, now later than before
· [b]Twilight Curse[/b]: this and other Morph effects now block any on-death attacks when afflicted foes are slain, with the exception of Inferno-Bombs
· [b]Prize of Poseidon (Moon Water)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Pride of Poseidon (Moon Water)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Godsent upgrade gradually restores Life and Magick over time
· [b]Zenith (Sky Fall)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with [b]Ambition[/b], which deals bonus damage to Guardians
· [b]Lineage[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Hex can be [b]Godsent[/b] one more time when used in Guardian Encounters

[h1]Keepsakes[/h1]
· [b]Discordant Bell[/b]: effect now persists for the night even after you switch Keepsakes

[h1]Resources & Reagents[/h1]
📢 Reduced chance of never finding the resource type aligned with your [b]Animal Familiar[/b] in shorter regions

[h1]Shrine of Hermes[/h1]
· [b]Fresh Sustenance MAX[/b]: reduced Life recovery

[h1]Foes & Dangers[/h1]
· Various adjustments to the new [b]Vow of Rivals[/b] Encounters, including...
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Typhon[/spoiler]: adjusted behaviors of [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler], who should no longer teleport in the middle of his strikes; adjusted patterns in final phase
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Chronos[/spoiler]: adjusted various behaviors; adjusted hitbox of Swipe attack; [spoiler]Tempii[/spoiler] no longer heal when affected by [b]Twilight Curse (Selene)[/b]; now summons only a single Warden
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Prometheus[/spoiler]: adjusted various behaviors of [spoiler]both combatants[/spoiler]; [spoiler]Heracles[/spoiler] has reduced Life; [spoiler]Aetos now briefly takes over if Prometheus is vanquished first[/spoiler]
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Cerberus[/spoiler]: updated behaviors in the initial phase
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Eris[/spoiler]: adjusted various behaviors; reduced how much of the field gets engulfed in flame
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Scylla[/spoiler]: adjusted various behaviors of [spoiler]each member of the band[/spoiler]
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Polyphemus[/spoiler]: adjusted various behaviors including his Grab move; [spoiler]Curing Pools[/spoiler] now clear nearby [spoiler]poison[/spoiler] when used, can be used more frequently, and can no longer can be destroyed
· [spoiler]Unrivaled Hecate[/spoiler]: increased effectiveness of mid-phase moves; reduced tracking and hit-stun on projectiles from [spoiler]Dark Side[/spoiler] and Sisters of the Dead

[h1]Art & Visual FX[/h1]
· Added alternate textures when using upgraded Tools of the Unseen
· Added visual FX to [spoiler]Typhon's Eggs[/spoiler]
· Updated visual FX when [b]Crescent Pick[/b] Outcroppings are depleted
· Added visual indicator in Boon Info for when Arcana are disabled due to [b]Barren (Chaos)[/b]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
📢 Melinoë now can greet Frinos while he is in the Training Grounds, as with the other Animal Familiars
📢 Gameplay Timer now also pauses automatically when interacting with the [b]Path of Stars[/b]
· [b]Heracles[/b] no longer sometimes ominously just stands around after his Encounters
· Updated presentation for [b]Icarus[/b] fly-by attacks
· Improved feedback on Life and Magick gauges after swapping Keepsakes that modify your totals
· Improved feedback spending resources in the [b]Altar of Ashes[/b], [b]Silver Pool[/b], and [b]Music Maker[/b] screens
· Improved contextual feedback on various Boons when affected by [b]Vow of Scars[/b]
· Damage from Specials and Omega Specials is now separated for some weapons on the [b]Victory Screen[/b]
· Reduced cluttered damage numbers using [b]Argent Skull (Medea)[/b]
· Added letterbox to the game intro in some aspect ratios
· Updates and fixes to translations in some languages

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
📢 Fixed an issue where Melinoë could suddenly take 500 damage using [b]Eruption (Path of Stars)[/b] and [b]Night Bloom (Selene)[/b] to raise a Tempus in the battle against Chronos...
📢 Fixed a number of story events that were never playing
📢 Fixed a number of contextual voice lines that were never playing
📢 Fixed cases where you would sometimes Dash-Strike unexpectedly using the [b]Moonstone Axe[/b]
📢 Fixed some interactions between [spoiler]Moonstone Axe (Nergal)[/spoiler] and [b]Psychic Whirlwind (Daedalus)[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Black Coat[/b] not interacting with some abilities that improved Channeling speed
📢 Fixed visual issues where strikes with Hidden Aspects sometimes appeared to be interrupted by foes
📢 Fixed Wounds from [b]Ares[/b] sometimes causing on-hit slowdowns too frequently
📢 Fixed [b]Sea Star (Poseidon)[/b] sometimes doubling items created by [b]Gold Gold Gold (Echo)[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Personal Loan (Dionysus)[/b] giving you nothing back if it got Rarified
📢 Fixed [b]Heracles[/b] sometimes turning invisible while attacking
· Fixed cases where [b]Athena[/b] could unexpectedly appear more than once per night
· Fixed [spoiler]Typhon[/spoiler] sometimes not taking damage from raised servants as expected
· Fixed cases where using Cast to interrupt Attacks or Specials would pause animations longer than expected
· Fixed [b]Past Deeds[/b] screen not showing more than 36 Boons if you had that many
· Fixed Satyr Supplicant Life Bars persisting after they were slain
· Fixed [b]Ares[/b] Plasma UI indicator sometimes disappearing unexpectedly
📢 Fixed several text errors
· Other minor fixes

[h1]Quote of the Patch[/h1]
[i]'In the past he wandered endlessly over the boundless earth and sea on missions ordered by lord Eurystheus; his reckless deeds were many and many the ordeals he suffered.'[/i]

[b]~The Homeric Hymns, 15: To Lion-Hearted Herakles[/b] (Homer; A. Athanassakis translation)

notes.title: Spread Fear in The Unseen Update
notes.content: [p]Our third [b]Major Update [/b]for [b][i]Hades II [/i][/b]is finally here, focused on expanding core combat, Guardian encounters, and character relationships, with lots of new visual flair![/p][previewyoutube="2Gv0eQjJ-gY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]About the Update[/h1][p]With [b]The Unseen Update[/b], expect [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] to be bigger and better than before: [/p][list][*][p]Discover the [b]Hidden Aspects [/b]of the [b]Nocturnal Arms[/b]! Each main weapon has an all-new new fighting style to unlock. [/p][/*][*][p]Speak the [b]Vow of Rivals [/b]at the [b]Oath of the Unseen [/b]to take on stronger-than-ever [b]Guardians[/b], each with unique surprises![/p][/*][*][p]Unleash [b]Godsent Hexes [/b]on your foes, dazzling Moon magick upgraded with the power of the Olympians.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Forge Bonds [/b]with a variety of characters in many new optional story events that bring you closer than before.[/p][/*][*][p]Harness the revamped [b]Umbral Flames[/b], now offering a snappier fighting style for keeping your foes at bay.[/p][/*][/list][p]This update also features lots of new artwork and visual flourishes, exciting new music tracks such as the one in our new trailer, new Warden encounters, many new story events, and more. We're excited to hear what you think of it all![/p][p][/p][h1]How to Get the Update[/h1][p][b]The Unseen Update [/b]is a free, automatic download as part of the Early Access development of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i]. If you've come directly to this post, check out the game here:  [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/"][/dynamiclink]You may need to restart your Steam client to initiate the download. If you run into [b]any technical issues[/b] with the update or the game in general, please check our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1145350/discussions/1/4361248648383659778/"][b]Technical Support FAQ[/b][/url] for solutions.[/p][p]As always, the complete [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1145350/view/512960174905888548"]Patch Notes[/url] are available here on Steam, in the game client, in the form of a dramatic reading [i](see below)[/i], and in [url="discord.gg/Supergiant"]our official Discord[/url], where you can join a welcoming community of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] players and Supergiant fans.[/p][previewyoutube="Luy1bWjMOeA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h1]Development Progress[/h1][p]After more than a year of Early Access development, we're now starting to prepare for our v1.0 launch! We're heading into the final phase of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] development, which involves adding the story's true ending and other finishing touches. Please note [u]we do not yet have a v1.0 launch date[/u], though we'll share more as soon as we can. We really appreciate your patience on this![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/527c3f7f1067bd540a52abc09722bef696050f58.png"][/img][/p][p]In terms of what we're working on, after any follow-up patches to [b]The Unseen Update[/b] that smooth out any issues, we'll focus on these major initiatives: [/p][list][*][p][b]The True Ending: [/b]The conclusion of Princess Melinoë's story is the main addition we're planning for our v1.0 launch. We have no plans for additional regions, encounters, abilities, and so on.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievements[/b]: With the game structure fully intact, we'll be adding Achievements in the lead-up to launch. Note you will [i]not[/i] need to start from the beginning to earn any Achievements.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Finishing Touches[/b]: We're continuing to polish and refine all the content we've introduced in [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i], from Boons and powers to artwork and story events.[/p][/*][/list][p]Sometimes the last stretch of development on a game can make all the difference, so we have always taken this phase seriously and appreciate your continued support.[/p][p][/p][h1]Onward to v1.0![/h1][p]As we wind down our Early Access phase, our goal remains ensuring we've created our biggest, most replayable, most feature-rich game yet, and — most importantly — a worthy successor to the original [i][b]Hades[/b][/i].[/p][p]We have a big game to wrap up! While we can't yet say when our v1.0 launch will be, we're very excited to be getting close, and to share the complete experience with you. This also means some of the most important work on [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] is still to come, so [i]may moonlight guide us![/i] And to all our Early Access players, thank you for being here, and sharing your impressions of [b]The Unseen Update [/b]with us.[/p]

tags.feature: Discover the Hidden Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms! Each main weapon has an all-new new fighting style to unlock.
Speak the Vow of Rivals at the Oath of the Unseen to take on stronger-than-ever Guardians, each with unique surprises!
Unleash Godsent Hexes on your foes, dazzling Moon magick upgraded with the power of the Olympians.
Forge Bonds with a variety of characters in many new optional story events that bring you closer than before.
Harness the revamped Umbral Flames, now offering a snappier fighting style for keeping your foes at bay.

notes.title: The Unseen Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/b0f0a9f506c58f5a61ad567e10744f666f580f47.png"][/img]Our third [b]Major Update[/b] in [b]Early Access[/b] is now available, featuring an all-new Hidden Aspect for [i]each[/i] of the Nocturnal Arms, a unique new variation of [i]each[/i] Guardian Encounter, and plenty of new story events, artwork, music, and more! Please check our [b]Development Roadmap[/b] for important details about our eventual [b]v1.0[/b] launch, and we'll be keeping a close eye on your feedback as we continue on!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
· [b]Hidden Aspects[/b]: Each of the Nocturnal Arms now has a secret, final form to discover...
· [b]Vow of Rivals[/b]: Reveal this in the [b]Oath of the Unseen[/b] for all-new challenges from each Guardian
· [b]Revamped Umbral Flames[/b]: The Flames of Ygnium now offer a smoother, snappier fighting style
· [b]Godsent Hexes[/b]: The [b]Path of Stars[/b] now can infuse each Selene Hex with a new Olympian power
· [b]Forge Bonds[/b]: Grow closer than ever to a variety of characters in numerous new optional events
· [b]New Wardens[/b]: Watch out for powerful new foes in Erebus and the City of Ephyra
· [b]Shinier Artwork[/b]: Look for new visual flourishes such as ambient effects on character portraits
· [b]New Music[/b]: Listen for new pieces including a hot new single from a certain band...

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
· In standard Encounters, new waves of foes now spawn slightly sooner, reducing downtime
· Your melee strikes are no longer negated by certain obstacles [i](foes behind them now get hit)[/i]
· Many attacks that briefly stunned you now slow you instead, reducing cases of being 'stun-locked'
· You now may exit Locations slightly sooner than before, right after collecting Rewards
· Melinoë's Olympic Slam entrances on [b]Olympus[/b] are faster and hit a slightly wider area
· Removed the infrequent second stage of [b]Rod of Fishing[/b] sequences; the initial interaction is unchanged

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
· [b]Sister Blades[/b]: increased Omega Special damage
· [b]Umbral Flames[/b]: reworked — adjusted properties of Attacks and Specials for improved flow and feel
· [b]Black Coat[/b]: increased Attack, Omega Attack, and Omega Special damage

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [spoiler]Witch's Staff (Anubis)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Create damage fields, draw foes in, and use Lone Shades to aid you
· [spoiler]Sister Blades (Morrigan)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Perform the devastating Blood Triad after your other moves
· [spoiler]Umbral Flames (Supay)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Fire on foes automatically, supercharging shots when necessary
· [spoiler]Moonstone Axe (Nergal)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Obliterate foes with heavy strikes, and go berserk to restore Life
· [spoiler]Argent Skull (Hel)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Fire continually without the need for Shells
· [spoiler]Black Coat (Shiva)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Absorb Omega Special blasts to destroy foes when their Life runs low
· [b]Witch's Staff (Melinoë)[/b]: reworked — now raises Magick and adds Power to your Specials
· [b]Witch's Staff (Circe)[/b]: reworked — whenever you use Casts, so does your Animal Familiar; this creates a Psychic Leash between you that damages foes
· [b]Sister Blades (Pan)[/b]: Omega Special recovery time now scales with the number of blades thrown
· [b]Umbral Flames (Melinoë)[/b]: reworked — now adds Critical damage chance to Attacks and Specials
· [b]Moonstone Axe (Charon)[/b]: no longer increases duration of your Casts
· [b]Argent Skull (Persephone)[/b]: bonus Omega Special duration now charges from Olympian damage; reworked passive benefit now automatically raises Boon Lv.
· [b]Black Coat (Nyx)[/b]: Nightspawn hits now also activate Olympian effects from the strike you used

[h1]Altar of Ashes[/h1]
· [b]Excellence[/b]: now also increases the chance of finding Legendary Boons
· [b]Strength[/b]: reduced damage resistance and bonus damage
· [b]Divinity[/b]: reduced chance of improved Rarity
· [b]The Unseen[/b]: improved Magick restoration
· While in Insights mode, you now can Inspect max-rank Arcana Cards for a closer look
· Adjusted upgrade costs of some Arcana Cards

[h1]Oath of the Unseen[/h1]
· [b]Vow of Rivals[/b]: [b]new![/b] Makes each Guardian more challenging in unique ways; the first Rank affects the first Guardian of both the Underworld and Surface routes; prevail against both to reveal the next Rank, and so on
· Reduced Fear required for Surface victories to become [spoiler]Night's Champion[/spoiler] according to [b]Schelemeus[/b]
📢 Added contextual feedback when Life restoration effects are being reduced by the [b]Vow of Scars[/b]
📢 The stasis effect from the [b]Stopper[/b] Perk from the [b]Vow of Fangs[/b] now is easier to anticipate

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· [b]Air Quality (Zeus)[/b]: increased damage minimum
· [b]Poseidon[/b]: Slip Curse replaced with [b]Froth[/b], which can make foes take a burst of damage when struck
· [b]Tidal Ring (Poseidon)[/b]: now hits foes in the binding circle instead of ahead, and inflicts Froth
· [b]Breaker Rush (Poseidon)[/b]: now deals more damage, and in an area around you
· [b]Fluid Gain (Poseidon)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Flood Gain (Poseidon)[/b]: your Omega Moves briefly restore any Magick used, repeatable after a delay
· [b]Sea Star (Poseidon)[/b]: increased effect chance
· [b]High Surf (Poseidon)[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Depth Charge (Poseidon)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Ocean Swell (Poseidon)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Omega Moves also launch a damaging wave, but use more Magick
· [b]Slippery Slope (Poseidon)[/b]: now also makes Froth deal more damage
· [b]Prominence Flare (Apollo)[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Tranquil Gain (Demeter)[/b]: Magick restoration effect starts sooner and is faster
· [b]Frosty Veneer (Demeter)[/b]: now reduces heavy damage above a certain threshold rather than capping it
· [b]Aphrodite[/b]: reduced duration of her Weak Curse
· [b]Life Affirmation (Aphrodite)[/b]: cut from game [i](sort of)[/i]; replaced with...
· [b]Spiritual Affirmation (Aphrodite)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Gain max Life and Magick, and future increases are worth more
· [b]Shameless Attitude (Aphrodite)[/b]: reduced bonus damage
· [b]Hephaestus[/b]: Vent Curse replaced with [b]Glow[/b], which makes foes take bonus damage
· [b]Volcanic Strike (Hephaestus)[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Volcanic Flourish (Hephaestus)[/b]: slightly reduced recharge time
· [b]Uncanny Fortitude (Hephaestus)[/b]: reduced Life gain
· [b]Mint Condition (Hephaestus)[/b]: cut from game [i](sort of)[/i]; replaced with...
· [b]Security System (Hephaestus)[/b]: [b]new![/b] At the start of each Encounter, gain a lot of Armor, but only briefly
· [b]Heavy Metal (Hephaestus)[/b]: reworked — gain Armor and deal more weapon damage based on it
· [b]Hestia[/b]: Increased damage rate of her Scorch Curse; fixed Scorch not counting as a damaging effect from Olympians, for interactions with Boons such as [b]Rallying Cry (Ares)[/b]
· [b]Flame Flourish (Hestia)[/b]: increased Scorch damage
· [b]Heat Rush (Hestia)[/b]: reworked — now leaves a damaging trail, and reduces damage you take from burning
· [b]Burnt Offering (Hestia)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Snuffed Candle (Hestia)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Deal bonus damage to isolated foes; previously [b]Single Elimination (Ares)[/b]
· [b]Fire Walk (Hestia)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Fire Away (Hestia)[/b]: [b]new Legendary![/b] Your Casts destroy many foes' ranged shots and inflict [b]Scorch[/b]
· [b]Ares[/b]: Improved visual clarity of Blood Drops, now called [b]Plasma[/b]
· [b]Mortal Gain (Ares)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Grisly Gain (Ares)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Striking foes may spill Plasma, which also restores Magick when collected
· [b]Single Elimination (Ares)[/b]: cut from game; this effect now is on a new [b]Hestia[/b] Boon, [b]Snuffed Candle[/b]
· [b]Mean Streak (Hermes)[/b]: increased duration of stacking damage bonus
· [b]Easy Shot (Artemis)[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Shadow Pounce (Artemis)[/b]: now gives Omega Moves a chance to deal Critical damage after you Dash
· [b]Whispered Prayer (Artemis)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Hex may deal Critical damage
· [b]Divine Dash (Athena)[/b]: reduced Deflect duration to match the original game
· [b]Task Force (Athena)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Godsent Hexes can be used more times per Encounter
· [b]Worry Free (Dionysus)[/b]: now gives a random amount of bonus Life within a range, rather than a set amount
· [b]Personal Loan (Dionysus)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Give up all your Gold; after the next Guardian, gain it back, with interest!
· [b]Reckless Abandon (Dionysus)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Attacks deal random damage from a set range of values
· [b]Cinerary Circle (Hades)[/b]: now spawns fewer, stronger Soul Urns that hit a wider area
· [b]Gigaros Dash (Hades)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Dash damages surrounding foes and briefly makes them take more damage from your Attack and Special
· [b]Unseen Ire (Hades)[/b]: no longer one of his initial offerings, but is offered after a certain point
· [b]Moonlight Dress (Arachne)[/b]: reworked — Outfit makes your Hexes charge using less Magick than before; the previous effect is now called [b]Gilded Dress[/b]
· [b]Crimson Dress (Arachne)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Outfit makes you deal more damage after each Encounter
· [b]Gold Gold Gold (Echo)[/b]: [b]new![/b] After your next purchase from Charon, gain another at no extra charge
· [b]Gift Gift Gift (Echo)[/b]: [b]new![/b] In the next Region, gain the basic effect of your current Keepsake
· [b]Harm for the Afflicted (Medea)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Inflicting Curses also deals damage to unafflicted foes
· [b]Word of Greater Girth (Circe)[/b]: now also raises your max Life
· [b]Hymn to the Eye of Night (Circe)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Hex deals bonus damage
· [b]Turning to a Simple Form (Circe)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Omega Moves have a chance to inflict Morph
· [b]Ingenious Strike (Icarus)[/b]: reworked — now gives bonus Lv. to your Attack Boon
· [b]Ingenious Flourish (Icarus)[/b]: reworked — now gives bonus Lv. to your Special Boon
· [b]Full Service (Icarus)[/b]: [b]new![/b] One of your Hammer enchantments is upgraded to Rank II
· [i]Note:[/i] Several of the new blessings noted above require first having reached a certain point in your relationship with the corresponding character
· Also adjusted power levels of various [b]Duo[/b] Boons, including...
· [b]Thermal Dynamics (Zeus x Hestia)[/b]: increased Scorch damage
· [b]Golden Rule (Hera x Poseidon)[/b]: increased bonus damage from Gold
· [b]Brave Face (Hera x Hephaestus)[/b]: reduced damage resistance from Magick
· [b]Incandescent Aura (Hera x Hestia)[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Natural Selection (Poseidon x Demeter)[/b]: increased chance of improved Rarity
· [b]Scalding Vapor (Poseidon x Hestia)[/b]: adjusted to work with the new Froth Curse
· [b]Love Handles (Aphrodite x Hephaestus)[/b]: reduced Heartthrob damage
· [b]Carnal Pleasure (Aphrodite x Ares)[/b]: now has a chance of creating a Heartthrob instead of guaranteeing one
· [b]Chain Reaction (Hephaestus x Hestia)[/b]: reduced timing window for the effect
· Removed several cases where Boons affecting your Cast prevented other such Boons from being offered
· Additional adjustments to some Boon bonuses from Rarity and [b]Poms of Power[/b]
· Further clarifications to descriptions for various Boons
· Various other minor fixes and adjustments

[h1]Daedalus Hammer Upgrades[/h1]
· [b]Melting Swipe (Staff)[/b]: reworked — Your Dash-Strike now deals heavy damage to Armor, instead of destroying a percentage of the total; adjusted [b]Melting[/b] upgrades for other weapons accordingly
· [b]Hidden Helix (Flames)[/b]: reworked — Your Specials create a bonus projectile; formerly [b]Triple Helix[/b]
· [b]Enduring Coil (Flames)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Omega Special lasts longer
· [b]Possessed Array (Skull)[/b]: losing Magick from retrieving Shells no longer charges your Hex
· Added unique enchantments for Hidden Aspects, replacing ones that do not work with them, including:
· [spoiler]Mirrored Ankh (Staff)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Your Omega Attack creates another damage field ahead of the first
· [spoiler]Soulfilled Ankh (Staff)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Your Attacks gain Power and hit a larger area
· [spoiler]Scarab Etchings (Staff)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Your Lone Shades deal bonus damage and may reappear after they hit
· [spoiler]Phantom Etchings (Blades)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Your Blood Triad combo deals even more damage
· [spoiler]Banshee Brand (Blades)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Your Blood Triad combo has a chance to strike once more
· [spoiler]Demonic Cell (Flames)[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] As long as you Sprint, your Attacks and Specials have bonus Power

notes.title: Early Access Patch 8 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/9aa99e99ab7819a4b59769605146ad8f6bf92eef.png[/img]
We appreciate all the feedback following last week's [b]Warsong Update[/b]! This patch includes fixes and targeted adjustments for a smoother play experience as you battle toward the final confrontation. We're now shifting focus to our [i]third[/i] [b]Major Update[/b] outlined in our [b]Roadmap[/b]. Until then, thank you for playing!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
· [b]Sister Blades[/b]: slightly increased speed of the first two strikes in the Attack sequence
· [b]Argent Skull[/b]: increased starting number of Shells; reduced Attack recovery time

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [b]Argent Skull (Melinoë)[/b]: reduced bonus Power per spent Shell now that the starting number is greater

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· [b]Heinous Affront (Zeus x Ares)[/b]: significantly increased how frequently this can affect foes
📢 [b]Premium Service (Hephaestus)[/b]: increased power level while using [b]Black Coat (Melinoë)[/b]
· [b]Success Rate (Hermes)[/b]: removed [b]Fig Leaf (Dionysus)[/b] as an offering requirement for this

[h1]Foes & Dangers[/h1]
· [spoiler]Typhon[/spoiler]: reduced damage and frequency of some attacks; adjusted Life and Armor of some minions; improved camera motion between phases
· [spoiler]Spawn of Typhon[/spoiler]: reduced damage of some attacks; reduced range and speed of headbutt attack

· [b]Satyr Sapper[/b]: reduced damage of ranged attack
· [b]Auto-Watcher[/b]: slightly reduced damage
· [b]Auto-Seeker[/b]: reduced damage of ranged attack
· [b]Blasket[/b]: reduced damage

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
📢 Improved feedback when gathering [b]Blood Drops[/b] from [b]Ares[/b]
📢 Increased appearance rate of Poppy Seeds in [b]Tartarus[/b]
· Updates and fixes to translations in some languages

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
📢 Fixed certain effects not increasing [b]Moonstone Axe[/b] Omega Special channeling speed as expected
📢 Fixed [b]Black Coat[/b]  Omega Attack having unintentionally reduced range in the previous patch
📢 Fixed [b]Extended Family (Hera)[/b] not being affected by Boons from [b]Artemis[/b], [b]Athena[/b], or  [b]Dionysus[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Nova Flourish (Apollo)[/b] not increasing the area of the [b]Moonstone Axe[/b] Omega Special
📢 Fixed [b]Steady Growth (Demeter)[/b] sometimes not working correctly
📢 Fixed [b]Mint Condition (Hephaestus)[/b] not functioning in the newest Warden encounter in [b]Thessaly[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Gorgon Amulet (Athena)[/b] sometimes summoning multiple [b]Athenas[/b] in the [b]Mourning Fields[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Fig Leaf (Dionysus)[/b] not functioning in the newest Warden encounter in [b]Thessaly[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Hermes[/b] sometimes unexpectedly showing up as the first Olympian on the surface over and over after reaching the final confrontation
📢 Fixed several narrative events related to the final confrontation playing or not playing when expected
📢 Fixed visual issues with the [b]Altar of Ashes[/b] in ultrawide resolutions
📢 Fixed a visual issue with the numbering on the [b]Death[/b] Arcana in the [b]Altar of Ashes[/b]
· Other minor fixes

[h1]Quote of the Patch[/h1]
[i]'Zeus now cast his new weapon, pale and blinding, through the fabric of the sky, ripping it end to end; then he hurled another, stronger, at his father: it fell like a white-hot sword thrust with inexorable force.'[/i]

[b]~Greek Myths: A New Retelling[/b] (C. Higgins)

notes.title: Strike True in The Warsong Update
notes.content:
Our second [b]Major Update[/b] for [b][i]Hades II[/i][/b] has arrived, featuring all-new encounters at the end of the surface route, the arrival of violence-loving Ares, updates to Arcana and resource collection, and much more!

[previewyoutube=yrpGYTlCjNQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]About the Update[/h1]
With [b]The Warsong Update[/b], [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] now packs these latest additions and improvements:
[list]
[*] Are you prepared for the [b]Final Confrontation[/b] on the surface? Discover what lies beyond the Guardian of [b]Olympus[/b]... if you dare!

[*] Meet [b]Ares[/b], the infamous god of war! Gain his varied and vicious [b]Boons[/b] to see if you can satisfy his thirst for blood.

[*] Meditate at the updated [b]Altar of Ashes[/b], featuring all-new art and several reworked Arcana effects! Many other menu screens are also improved.

[*] Bond with a new [b]Animal Familiar[/b], who will help keep you out of harm's way! See if you can recruit all five Familiars to your cause.

[*] Why not sing a duet in the [b]Crossroads[/b] as you rest up from a hard night? Look for other new details and interactions!

[*] Delve deeper into the story, with more than [b]2,000 new voice lines[/b] and new events with most of the game's cast!
[/list]
This update also introduces a slew of new music tracks, many new and improved Boons, streamlined resource gathering, and more! 

[h1]How to Get the Update[/h1]
[b]The Warsong Update[/b] is a free, automatic download as part of the Early Access development of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i]. If you've come directly to this post, check out the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/

You may need to restart your Steam client to initiate the download. If you run into [b]any technical issues[/b] with the update or the game in general, please check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1145350/discussions/1/4361248648383659778/][b]Technical Support FAQ[/b][/url] for solutions.

As always, the complete [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1145350/view/503942841152569404]Patch Notes[/url] are available here on Steam, in the game client, in the form of a dramatic reading [i](see below)[/i], and in [url=discord.gg/Supergiant]our official Discord[/url], where you can join a welcoming community of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] players and Supergiant fans.
[previewyoutube=4f9kfe1E87U;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Development Progress[/h1]
We're excited to have launched this Major Update, since it includes numerous ideas we've been eager to implement since we started working on [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] years ago! But we're not finished yet, and have already made plans for our [i]third[/i] Major Update, which we intend to deliver some months from now. Note it's still too early to share our plans beyond that, including when our v1.0 launch will be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/46ec94b62d0db5632525052ae2623b6acfbcd033.png[/img]
After any follow-up patches to [b]The Warsong Update[/b] that address issues or feedback we think we can resolve in the short term, we'll focus on these major initiatives:
[list]
[*][b]Hidden Aspects[/b]: The Nocturnal Arms still have some secrets left to be discovered, and new ways for you to play. We plan for you to be able to wield some of these next time.

[*][b]Enhanced Guardians[/b]: The boss battles at the end of each Region are an integral part of the experience, and we want them to be able to challenge and surprise you even more.

[*][b]Expanded Story[/b]: As we prepare for our eventual v1.0 launch, we're planning ahead for the rest of the story, while building on various character relationships and subplots.
[/list]
We appreciate your continued patience and support as we forge ahead!

[h1]Beyond the Final Confrontation![/h1]
Early Access continues to be an essential part of [b][i]Hades II[/i][/b] development, and we hope you can feel this reflected in our Major Updates and other patches so far. With the core structure of both the Underworld and Surface routes now fully intact, we're excited to turn our attention to filling out more of the game's content categories, finishing more and more of what we started... until we're done!

In the meantime, thank you very much for playing [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i]! You're helping us get closer to achieving our goal of making our first-ever sequel our biggest, most replayable game yet, and a worthy successor to the original [b][i]Hades[/i][/b] that's filled with its own surprises and special touches. For now, we'll be looking forward to your impressions of [b]The Warsong Update[/b], and hearing of your adventures above the surface and below!

notes.title: The Warsong Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/a0df1f009d04285fea7d7e0b3fca85d6935656e8.png[/img]
Our second [b]Major Update[/b] has arrived, featuring the final confrontation of the surface route, one last Olympian and all his Boons, a new Animal Familiar to bond with, streamlined resource gathering, plenty of new music and artwork, and more! We're excited to know what you think, and will be monitoring feedback in the coming weeks to ensure these latest additions are working properly.

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
· [b]The Final Confrontation[/b]: Battle to the summit of [b]Mount Olympus[/b] and discover what awaits...
· [b]New Olympian[/b]: Meet the god of war himself, and choose from his many Boons
· [b]New Familiar[/b]: Find one last animal companion to join your journey and aid you in battle
· [b]Revamped Boons[/b]: Gain many powerful new and improved blessings from various Olympians
· [b]Revamped Altar of Ashes[/b]: Activate several reworked effects, and each Card now has all-new artwork
· [b]Revamped Resource Gathering[/b]: Worry no more about which resources you can collect
· [b]Revamped Menus[/b]: Look for new and improved animations across many menu screens
· [b]Expanded Story[/b]: Discuss the final confrontation and more with many different characters

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
· You no longer prioritize [b]Gathering Tools[/b] in the Training Grounds, though still can harvest any type of resource as long as you have unlocked each Tool; resource appearance rates adjusted as part of this
· [b]Psyche[/b] can no longer be found as a Location Reward; [b]Bones[/b] may now be found sooner instead
· All Guardians and Wardens with Guardian-style Life Bars now are resistant to the slowing effect of your Casts; previously this applied only to some of them
· Any damage resistance effects you have no longer affect any Armor you have
📢 Added a longer visual warning before taking damage from magma and fire effects
· Adjusted requirements for certain key events early on; as a result, it should be possible to reach the surface earlier than before

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
· [b]Witch's Staff[/b]: Attack sequence is faster and the final strike is stronger; Omega Attack is stronger; reworked Special is a fast powerful shot that pierces foes
· [b]Argent Skull[/b]: reworked Attack fires straight ahead; Omega Attack is stronger; Special now retrieves Shells in the surrounding area
· [b]Black Coat[/b]: increased Omega Attack damage; your Dash no longer cancels channeling your Omega Attack and causes you to perform the move right after

[h1]Altar of Ashes[/h1]
· All Cards now have unique illustrations; swapped or adjusted themes of several Cards, noted below
· [b]Eternity[/b]: theme changed from [b]Night[/b]; reworked — now makes everything slower while you channel Omega moves; note this effect is no longer on [b]Silver Wheel (Hecate)[/b]
· [b]The Messenger[/b]: reworked — your Casts briefly make you impervious and move faster
· [b]The Swift Runner[/b]: your Sprint now also makes you phase through foes
· [b]Night[/b]: reduced Grasp cost; theme changed from [b]Death[/b]
· [b]The Wayward Son[/b]: no longer provides doubled recovery at low Life; base recovery improved
· [b]Death[/b]: theme changed from [b]Eternity[/b]
· [b]Persistence[/b]: theme changed from [b]The Titan[/b]
· [b]The Enchantress[/b]: theme changed from [b]The Fates[/b]
· [b]The Fates[/b]: theme changed from [b]The Seer[/b]
· [b]Grasp[/b] upgrade costs re-scaled as part of changes to resource gathering

[h1]Oath of the Unseen[/h1]
· Added new [b]Testaments[/b] for the final confrontation
· [b]Vow of Shadow[/b]: adjusted various encounters with this
📢 [b]Vow of Fangs[/b]: removed certain combinations of Perks that were unusually cruel...
📢 Fear requirements for some Testaments re-scaled to reduce jumps in difficulty; reduced Fear requirements in some cases

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· Added [b]Ares[/b], with many of his own blessings, including a new [b]Duo[/b] with each other primary Boon-giver
· [b]Zeus[/b]: his [b]Blitz[/b] Curse now activates at the end of the duration if not activated by dealing damage
· [b]Storm Ring (Zeus)[/b]: slightly reduced rate of lightning strikes
· [b]Thunder Rush (Zeus)[/b]: no longer requires Magick to strike foes with lightning; formerly [b]Thunder Sprint[/b]
· [b]Electric Overload (Zeus)[/b]: reworked — your chain-lightning effects are stronger and bounce to more foes
· [b]Toasting Fork (Zeus)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Arc Flash (Zeus)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Omega Moves activate your Blitz effects and make them stronger
· [b]Romantic Spark (Zeus x Aphrodite)[/b]: reduced damage bonus
· [b]Hera[/b]: the Queen of the Olympians now has Boons of all four elemental affinities, not solely Earth
· [b]Engagement Ring (Hera)[/b]: reworked — now deals immediate damage for each foe in the binding circle
· [b]Bridal Glow (Hera)[/b]: reworked — upgrades a random Boon to Heroic Rarity and gives it bonus Pom Lv.
· [b]Nasty Comeback (Hera)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Extended Family (Hera)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Olympian damage is stronger for each Olympian you met this night
· [b]Proper Upbringing (Hera)[/b]: increased activation requirement to include all four elements
· [b]Breaker Rush (Poseidon)[/b]: reworked — whenever you Sprint, damage and knock away the first foe you run into; formerly [b]Breaker Sprint[/b]
· [b]Geyser Spout (Poseidon)[/b]: reworked — your Omega Cast gains Power and knocks foes away
· [b]Buried Treasure (Poseidon)[/b]: now also drops [b]Bones[/b], not [b]Ashes[/b] or [b]Psyche[/b]; formerly [b]Ocean's Bounty[/b]
· [b]Flood Control (Poseidon)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]High Surf (Poseidon)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Hit surrounding foes with a splash as they strike, but prime some Magick
· [b]Phoenix Skin (Apollo x Hestia)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Warm Breeze (Apollo x Hestia)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Whenever Dodge or Daze makes foes miss, restore some Life
· [b]Demeter:[/b] her [b]Gust[/b] effects no longer destroy trees in Erebus or other such obstructions
· [b]Local Climate (Demeter)[/b]: reworked — your Omega Cast is stronger; bonus doubled in the binding circle
· [b]Plentiful Forage (Demeter)[/b]: now restores Life whenever you gather any resource
· [b]Rare Crop (Demeter)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Steady Growth (Demeter)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Whenever you clear enough Encounters, a Boon gains Rarity
· [b]Secret Crush (Aphrodite)[/b]: now also affects Omega Attack
· [b]Tough Gain (Hephaestus)[/b]: reworked — whenever you take damage, shrug some off and restore Magick
· [b]Flash Fry (Hestia)[/b]: no longer requires foes to have Scorch to explode when slain; no longer requires a Scorch-related Boon to be offered; formerly [b]Natural Gas[/b]
· [b]Burnt Offering (Hestia)[/b]: reworked — gain max Magick whenever you collect Ashes, and gain some now
· [b]Mean Streak (Hermes)[/b]: damage bonus no longer automatically ends after Encounters
· [b]Tall Order (Hermes)[/b]: updated elemental requirement; slightly increased damage bonus
· [b]Travel Deal (Hermes)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your first purchase each Location costs less; another item appears after
· [b]Saved Breath (Hermes)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Winner's Circle (Hermes)[/b]: [b]new![/b] You channel your Casts faster and your Casts expire faster
· [b]Witty Retort (Hermes)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Hasty Retreat (Hermes)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Gain more Dodge chance and move speed the more Boons you have
· [b]Greater Evasion (Hermes)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Stutter Step (Hermes)[/b]: [b]new![/b] You can Dash more frequently
· [b]Midnight Oil (Hermes)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Success Rate (Hermes)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your chance-based effects are more likely to occur, except Dodge or Daze
· [b]Close Call (Hermes)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Paid Dues (Hermes)[/b]: [b]new Legendary![/b] Whenever you take damage, you lose Gold before you lose Life
· [b]Mental Block (Athena)[/b]: reduced duration of Impervious effect
· [b]Righteous Pike (Athena)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Whenever you use enough Magick, several foes are struck by spears
· [b]Killing Stroke (Artemis)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Specials may deal Critical damage, but you prime some Magick
· The [b]Marked[/b] Curses inflicted by [b]Artemis[/b] and [b]Raki the Raven[/b] now will never choose the same target
· [b]Unseen Ire (Hades)[/b]: the Dark effect and its damage bonus no longer expire after you strike
📢 [b]Barren (Chaos)[/b]: reduced Curse duration
· [b]Neurotic (Chaos)[/b]: no longer slows your Dash but still makes it use Magick; formerly [b]Hobbled[/b]
· [b]Life Savings (Narcissus)[/b]: now gives [b]Lotus[/b] instead of [b]Deathcaps[/b]
· [b]Wealth from the Dead (Medea)[/b]: you now automatically absorb bonus Gold from slain foes on approach
· [b]Supply Drop (Icarus)[/b]: slightly reduced frequency of drops, and provides one fewer Pom Slice
· Adjusted names and elemental affinities of some Boons
· Additional minor adjustments to some bonuses from Rarity and [b]Poms of Power[/b]
· Further clarifications to descriptions for various Boons
· Other minor fixes and adjustments

[h1]Daedalus Hammer Upgrades[/h1]
· [b]Spiral Knives (Blades)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Hidden Knives (Blades)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Specials are stronger and Omega Special fires more shots than usual
· [b]Fetching Array (Skull)[/b]: Shells now also automatically return faster; removed penalty to total Shells
· [b]Looming Ignition (Skull)[/b]: now also affects your Omega Attack; reaches full strength faster
· [b]Possessed Array (Skull)[/b]: increased Magick cost
· [b]Rocket Bombard (Skull)[/b]: cut from game since this effect is now innate; replaced with...
· [b]Boosted Ignition (Skull)[/b]: [b]new![/b] After your Dash or Specials, your Attacks are faster and gain Power
· [b]Counter Barrage[/b]: now launches more rockets, more often
· Adjusted names and descriptive text for several Daedalus Hammer upgrades

[h1]Keepsakes[/h1]
· Added a new Keepsake now that [b]Ares[/b] decided to show up, which you can gain in the customary way
· [b]Silver Wheel (Hecate)[/b]: reworked — adds to your Magick limit for the rest of the night
· [b]Fig Leaf (Dionysus)[/b]: now can only affect one Encounter per Region, but still works if you unequip it
· [b]Engraved Pin (Moros)[/b]: now counts as a Death Defiance effect
📢 [b]Evil Eye (Nemesis)[/b]: now targets [b]Prometheus[/b] if his Eagle [b]Aetos[/b] is the one to vanquish you

[h1]Animal Familiars[/h1]
· [spoiler]Gale the Polecat[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Grants Dodge chance and move speed, blocks damage a few times per Region
📢 [b]Toula the Cat[/b]: attacks more times successively; falls asleep faster [i](so she can wake back up faster!)[/i]

[h1]Resources & Reagents[/h1]
· Added several new collectable resources found around the final confrontation
· Removed [b]Deathcaps[/b] from the game as part of broader changes to resources described further above

[h1]Well of Charon[/h1]
📢 [b]Yarn of Ariadne[/b]: no longer consumed when meeting [b]Hades[/b], on whom this has no effect

[h1]Shrine of Hermes[/h1]
· [b]Fresh Sustenance MAX[/b]: reduced Life recovery
· Reduced chance of offering Minor Finds over other types of items

[h1]Foes & Dangers[/h1]
· Added a variety of foes for the final surface Region, including new Wardens and a new Guardian
· [b]Prometheus[/b]: adjusted behaviors; reduced damage for several moves; now sometimes foresees and dodges attacks, yet overall should be somewhat less punishing than before
· [b]Aetos[/b]: reduced viciousness to some extent...
· [b]Sky-Dracon[/b]: slightly reduced tracking speed
· [b]Auto-Seeker[/b]: slightly reduced tracking speed
· [b]Eris[/b]: improved previews of her various attacks
· [spoiler]The Yargonaut[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Warden added to the [b]Rift of Thessaly[/b]
· [b]Charybdis[/b]: adjusted Tentacle behaviors; reduced overall difficulty
· [b]Harpy Talon[/b]: slightly reduced radius of ranged attack
· [b]Stickler[/b]: reduced damage
· [b]Seesword[/b]: increased damage
· [b]Blasket[/b]: reduced damage
· [b]Infernal Beast[/b]: slightly increased Life
· [b]Scylla[/b]: slightly increased Life
· [spoiler]Hellifish[/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Warden added to [b]Oceanus[/b]
· [b]Lurker[/b]: gained a defensive back-step maneuver after getting hit
· [b]Headmistress Hecate[/b]: slightly increased Life
· [b]Root-Stalker[/b]: adjusted behavior of tail; grew a second one
· Various other minor changes to foes and combat encounters

[h1]Special Encounters[/h1]
📢 Reworked [b]Heracles[/b] combat encounters — vanquish specially-marked foes for a bounty in Gold
· [b]Aetos[/b] will no longer swoop in to attack more than once prior to facing [b]Prometheus[/b]
· Slightly increased appearance rate of [b]Moon Monuments[/b] and [b]Unseen Sigils[/b] on the surface
· Slightly increased difficulty of [b]Moon Monument[/b] foes
📢 [b]Moon Monuments[/b] no longer offer [b]Path of Stars[/b] rewards if your Hex is fully upgraded
📢 [b]Athena[/b] more consistently vanquishes [b]Revenants[/b] from the [b]Vow of Return (Oath)[/b]
· Minor adjustments to [b]Artemis[/b], [b]Heracles[/b], and [b]Icarus[/b] appearance rates on the surface route
· Two [b]Arachne[/b] Cocoon encounters can no longer occur very close together in some cases
· [b]Family Disputes[/b], formerly called [b]Trials of the Gods[/b], now can include [b]Ares[/b]; several Olympians put up more of a fight than before...

[h1]Level Design & Environments[/h1]
· Added the final confrontation on the surface route and various new Locations within it
· The [b]Olympus[/b] Region has one fewer Location to traverse before the Guardian
· Encounters in the [b]Rift of Thessaly[/b] that had too many waves [i](of foes)[/i] should now be more reasonable
📢 Optional rooms in [b]Ephyra[/b] become more likely if you haven't found many that night
· Reduced damage of Lone Shades freed from [b]Ephyra Pylons[/b]
· You now must use the Fountain if you haven't already done so prior to leaving the [b]Ephyra[/b] main square
· Resources can appear in more places in the [b]Ephyra[/b] main square
· Removed Bat Cage nearest to the initial entrance to the [b]Ephyra[/b] main square
· Added another Location that can randomly appear in [b]Erebus[/b]
· Added another Location that can randomly appear in [b]Oceanus[/b]
· Added another Location that can randomly appear in [b]Ephyra[/b]
· The final battle prior to the Guardian of each of Region should no longer get replaced by Fountain chambers or character encounters
· Adjusted resource points in some Locations, especially those close enough to exits that you could leave by accident while trying to harvest
· Various minor fixes and improvements to various Locations

[h1]Chaos Trials[/h1]
📢 You now reappear before the [b]Pitch-Black Stone[/b] upon returning from a Chaos Trial
