notes.title: Early Access Patch 6 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/f664cf0ac2e16c6b7494668ae549ba075b740649.png[/img]
This patch includes targeted fixes and improvements we could make relatively soon after last week's big launch of the [b]Olympic Update[/b]. We're continuing to monitor your feedback as we look ahead toward what's next, as outlined in our [b]Roadmap[/b]. Thank you for playing, and good luck with the climb!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
· You now can break urns and other objects when you Sprint into them
· Increased the attack range of Lone Shades, including ones trapped in [b]Ephyra[/b] Pylons
· [b]Sister Blades[/b]: Omega Special shots now pierce foes [i](excluding the Aspect of Pan's homing shots)[/i]
· [b]Moonstone Axe[/b]: Omega Attack channels faster
· [spoiler][b]Black Coat[/b][/spoiler]: Omega Special locks on faster; works more reliably when used in quick succession

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· [b]Happy Haze ([spoiler]Dionysus[/spoiler])[/b]: [spoiler]Festive Fog[/spoiler] effect now also repeatedly stuns susceptible foes

[h1]Pool of Purging[/h1]
· Reduced Gold value of Infusion Boons

[h1]Foes & Dangers[/h1]
· [spoiler][b]Prometheus[/b][/spoiler]: adjusted Flame Strike patterns; slightly reduced uppercut speed; kick and flurry not quite as punishing; improved visual clarity of some of his moves; he is now perhaps more fittingly Titan-sized...
· [b]Eris[/b]: reduced number of phases; improved feedback on where she is aiming with some Rail attacks; reduced duration of her temporary damage bonus
· [spoiler][b]Talos[/b][/spoiler]: slightly reduced Life
· [spoiler][b]Mega-Dracon[/b][/spoiler]: slightly reduced Armor; fixed issues with it flying out of bounds
· [spoiler][b]Auto-Watcher[/b][/spoiler]: reduced damage; reduced tracking speed; reduced Elite Armor
· [spoiler][b]Snow-Shambler[/b][/spoiler]: reduced Life
· [spoiler][b]Harpy Raptor[/b][/spoiler]: reduced Life
· [spoiler][b]Satyr Sapper[/b][/spoiler]: reduced tracking speed; fewer should appear at once
· [spoiler][b]Satyr Raider[/b][/spoiler]: reduced damage of some attacks
· [spoiler][b]Satyr Goldpike[/b][/spoiler]: reduced damage of some attacks
· [b]Charybdis[/b]: reduced tentacle damage; slightly reduced Life; slightly reduced frequency of ranged attacks
· [b]Headmistress Hecate[/b]: her Twilight Curse can no longer be blocked using the [spoiler][b]Black Coat[/b][/spoiler]

[h1]Special Encounters[/h1]
📢 Significantly reduced how quickly [b]Nemesis[/b] and [b]Heracles[/b] sometimes snatch items from [b]Charon[/b]
· Reduced chances of not having any foes to drop in on when launching into [spoiler]Olympus[/spoiler] Encounters

[h1]Animal Familiars[/h1]
· [spoiler][b]Raki the Raven[/b][/spoiler]: no longer has hidden damage bonuses against certain types of foe; fixed incorrect text for Marked effect duration, though the duration itself is unchanged
📢 [spoiler][b]Hecuba the Hound[/b][/spoiler]: no longer as prone to waiting around prior to digging

[h1]Oath of the Unseen[/h1]
· [b]Vow of Shadows[/b]: now affects [b]Charybdis[/b] and [spoiler][b]Talos[/b][/spoiler], so beware!

[h1]Art & Visual FX[/h1]
📢 Improved look and clarity of [b]Harpy[/b] cyclone attack
· Various other minor visual improvements

[h1]Voice & Narrative[/h1]
· Adjusted how often [b]Headmistress Hecate[/b] and [b]Chronos[/b] speak during battle
· Adjusted priority and requirements for various voice lines and narrative events
· Numerous other minor fixes and improvements

[h1]Music & SFX[/h1]
📢 Fixed [b]Sister Blades (Artemis)[/b] sound not playing for the [b]Riposte[/b] effect
📢 Adjusted some sound effects for [spoiler][b]Black Coat (Nyx)[/b][/spoiler], though these are still in progress
· Adjusted some sound effects for [b]Charybdis[/b]; improved music timing at the end of the fight
· Adjusted sound effects when [b]Eris[/b] gets dragged back to the Underworld
· Improved blast sound for [b]Beach Ball (Poseidon x Apollo)[/b]
· Other minor fixes and improvements

[h1]Menus & UI[/h1]
📢 The [b]Crossroads Renewal[/b] menu now re-opens after unlocking new decorations
· Added menu text for unlocking, swapping, and removing decorations
📢 The [b]Music Maker[/b] menu likewise now re-opens after unlocking new music

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
📢 The [b]Victory Screen[/b] now reveals your current Life if you have [b]Worry Free ([spoiler]Dionysus[/spoiler])[/b]
· You now can interact with the exits in the [b]Mourning Fields[/b] from farther away
· Aspects of the [spoiler][b]Black Coat[/b][/spoiler] are no longer revealed immediately after you unlock the weapon
· The moon beam surrounding the [b]Pitch-Black Stone[/b] now dims if you have no uncleared [b]Chaos Trials[/b]
· Added feedback when attempting to block unblockable attacks using the [spoiler][b]Black Coat[/b][/spoiler]
· Improved collision near the exit from the [b]Training Grounds[/b] back to the rest of the [b]Crossroads[/b]
· Added more contextual hints for why various comrades may be uninterested in your various gifts
· You now can re-map the commands when using the [b]Tablet of Peace[/b] to compel Shades
· Clarified descriptive text for several Boons
· Various other minor text changes

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
· Fixed an issue with the [b]Wretched Broker[/b] where you could keep using Sell All without selling all...
📢 Fixed [b]Dora[/b] unexpectedly never showing up night after night despite claiming to enjoy the tent
📢 Fixed [b]Silken Sash (Arachne)[/b] removing added Armor if you switched to a different Keepsake
📢 Fixed Shrine of Hermes expedited deliveries sometimes dropping out of bounds in the new Region
📢 Fixed [b]Sureshot Flurry (Daedalus - Blades)[/b] not increasing Special range
📢 Fixed [b]Furious Rockets (Daedalus - Coat)[/b] not increasing Omega Special speed
📢 Fixed [b]Burnt Offering (Hestia)[/b] sometimes purging a different Boon than indicated
📢 Fixed [spoiler][b]Satyr Raider[/b][/spoiler] not taking damage from opposing [spoiler][b]Automatons[/b][/spoiler]
📢 Fixed [spoiler][b]Auto-Forcer[/b][/spoiler] damaging itself while afflicted with [b]Charm[/b]
📢 Fixed [spoiler][b]Toula[/b][/spoiler] sliding around uncontrollably during the final confrontation with [b]Chronos[/b]
📢 Fixed reward in the [b]Rift of Thessaly[/b] Fountain Chamber being unalterable
📢 Fixed several Boons not showing Offering Requirements in the [b]Book of Shadows[/b]
· Fixed exit sounds in the [b]Rift of Thessaly[/b] and the new Region cutting off unexpectedly
· Fixed [b]Music Maker[/b] music playing unexpectedly during the [spoiler]Hypnos dream sequence[/spoiler] and while fishing
· Fixed a visual issue in the destruction animation for [spoiler][b]Talos[/b][/spoiler]
· Fixed various minor visual issues in some Locations
· Other minor fixes

[h1]Quote of the Patch[/h1]
[i]'There is no way of deceiving or evading the mind of Zeus, since not even Iapetos' son, sly Prometheus, escaped the weight of his wrath, and for all his cleverness a strong fetter holds him in check.'[/i]

[b]~Theogony[/b] (Hesiod; M.L. West translation)

notes.title: Seize Victory in The Olympic Update
notes.content:
Our first [b]Major Update[/b] for [b][i]Hades II[/i][/b] is finally here, featuring spectacular new places to explore, colorful new characters to meet, a wild new weapon to master, and much, much more! Take a peek:

[previewyoutube=WH3jT53hIYM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]About the Update[/h1]
[i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] takes a big step forward with the following new features:
[list]
[*] Battle across the surface through an [b]all-new Region[/b] where the gods themselves are desperate for your aid! Can you vanquish the deadly new [b]Guardian[/b]?

[*] Unlock the last of the Nocturnal Arms: [b]Xinth, the Black Coat[/b], a devastating new weapon with its own unique [b]Aspects[/b]!

[*] Spruce up the [b]Crossroads[/b] with dozens of unlockable decorations and music tracks, adding a personal touch to your home between the realms!

[*] Meet two [b]new Allies[/b]! Gain their blessings, learn their secrets, and use their unique [b]Keepsakes[/b]!

[*] Bond with two [b]new Animal Familiars[/b], loyal companions who will serve you through thick and thin!

[*] Feeling tough? Take on [b]new Challenges[/b], including new [b]Vows[/b] for the [b]Oath of the Unseen[/b], and the mysterious new [b]Moon Monument[/b] and [b]Unseen Sigil[/b]!

[*] Discover more of the story, with close to [b]2,500 new voice lines[/b] for the game's big, colorful cast!
[/list]
This update also adds [b]native support for Mac systems with Apple M1 or later[/b], numerous quality-of-life improvements, plenty of new art and audio, and other little surprises we're excited for you to find! 

[h1]How to Get the Update[/h1]
[b]The Olympic Update[/b] is a free, automatic download as part of the Early Access development of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i]. If you've come directly to this post, check out the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/

You may need to restart your Steam client to initiate the download. If you run into [b]any technical issues[/b] with the update or the game in general, please check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1145350/discussions/1/4361248648383659778/][b]Technical Support FAQ[/b][/url] for solutions.

The complete [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1145350/view/7057794870234137716]Patch Notes[/url] are available here on Steam, in the game client, in the form of a dramatic reading [i](see below)[/i], and in [url=discord.gg/Supergiant]our official Discord[/url], where you can join a welcoming community of [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] players and Supergiant fans.
[previewyoutube=PQtih_yy6IA;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]Development Progress[/h1]
Our first Major Update introduces a third Region and Guardian to the Surface Route, bringing it closer to the Underworld route's level of completion. We've also added the game's sixth and final main weapon, and iterated on a number of key systems. But there's plenty more to come, and we can safely say that our [i]next[/i] Major Update in Early Access will [i]not[/i] be our last!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/2751125722f24b12702413ce7d1bc1736fa2aa68.png[/img]
Once we're sure [b]The Olympic Update[/b] has stabilized and we've addressed major feedback as much as possible, we'll then focus on these major initiatives:
[list]
[*][b]Climactic Confrontation[/b]: What awaits further beyond the newly-added Region? Once we add that, we will consider the main structure of the Surface Route to be complete.

[*][b]New Boons[/b]: Boons are integral to the experience of [b][i]Hades II[/i][/b], so we have some more additions planned on this front. Surely the Olympians deserve no less!

[*][b]New Foes[/b]: We plan to add even more combat encounter variety. Having lots of exciting and varied encounters helps keep [b][i]Hades II[/i][/b] feeling fresh for as long as you play it.
[/list]
We are planning our next Major Update to launch sometime in early 2025, in a little less development time overall than [b]The Olympic Update[/b]. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we press on!

[h1]Onward and Upward![/h1]
Early Access has already been an invaluable and eye-opening experience for our team as we continue working to complete this game. As we move forward, we intend to keep making additions, changes, and improvements in an effort to create the biggest, most replayable, most feature-rich game we've made yet, and — most importantly — a worthy successor to the original [b][i]Hades[/i][/b].

We're very grateful that you've taken the time to play [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] thus far, and hope you find it's getting closer to fulfilling its potential with the launch of [b]The Olympic Update[/b]. Your feedback is always welcome, and thank you for playing.

notes.title: The Olympic Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/e3ad572b5e9082c606de2fe19db9ff1ca0ae8c46.png[/img]
Our first [b]Major Update[/b] is finally here, featuring an all-new Region to explore, a new weapon to master, more characters to meet, new decorations for the Crossroads, new Animal Familiars to bond with, new music and artwork, and [i]much[/i] more! We hope you enjoy discovering it all. In the coming weeks, we will be looking closely at player feedback to ensure our latest changes are solid. Until then!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
· [b]New Region[/b]: Can you reach [spoiler][b]Olympus[/b], the mountain of the gods[/spoiler]? And if so... can you save it?
· [b]New Weapon[/b]: Wield the otherworldly might of [spoiler][b]Xinth, the Black Coat[/b][/spoiler]  — last of the Nocturnal Arms
· [b]New Characters[/b]: Track down two new allies on their home turf and earn their favor
· [b]New Familiars[/b]: You now can bond with two new animal companions... once you find them!
· [b]Crossroads Renewal[/b]: Unlock dozens of new cosmetic items to liven up the [b]Crossroads[/b] your way
· [b]Expanded Story[/b]: Discover hours of new dialogue, as the plot thickens once you reach the new Region
· [b]World Map[/b]: Look for this new presentation when moving from one Region of the world to another
· [b]Mac Support[/b]: The game now runs natively on Macs on Apple M1 or later

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
· [b]Witch's Staff[/b]: reworked Special is faster and bounces between foes
· [b]Sister Blades[/b]: reworked Special pierces foes and returns to you, potentially hitting foes more than once
· [b]Umbral Flames[/b]: Special projectiles spin left or right depending on your movement
· [b]Moonstone Axe[/b]: reworked Special is a rising slash that strikes several times, but no longer blocks foes
· [spoiler][b]Black Coat[/b][/spoiler]: [b]new![/b] Guard and retaliate with mighty Attacks, letting none escape with seeking Specials
· Your [b]Dash[/b] is innately faster and more responsive
· You now can more reliably Dash out of hit-stun effects from certain foes' strikes
· It should be easier to aim certain abilities using gamepad

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [b]Umbral Flames (Moros)[/b]: re-scaled upgrades; slightly reduced fully-upgraded blast damage
· [b]Argent Skull (Medea)[/b]: increased Attack & Special damage; improved upgrades; Shells now load faster
· [spoiler][b]Black Coat[/b][/spoiler]: added its own three different unlockable, upgradeable Aspects

[h1]Crossroads Cauldron[/h1]
· [b]Eyes of Night and Darkness[/b]: [b]new![/b] Makes [b]Moon Monuments[/b] and [b]Unseen Sigils[/b] sometimes appear in Locations, further described below
· [b]Earthly Fortune[/b]: [b]new![/b] Lets you recycle unneeded resources at the [b]Wretched Broker[/b], in exchange for [b]Prestige[/b], used for decorative items
· [b]Summoning of Musical Rhapsody[/b]: [b]new![/b] Required to summon the [b]Music Maker[/b], who lets you unlock different music to play in the [b]Crossroads[/b]
· [b]Spreading of Ashes[/b]: [b]new![/b] Lets you save multiple Arcana arrangements in the [b]Altar of Ashes[/b]
· [b]Favored of All Keepsakes[/b]: [b]new![/b] Lets you designate a Keepsake to auto-equip in the [b]Training Grounds[/b]
· [b]Abyssal Reflections[/b]: [b]new![/b] Lets you re-attempt cleared [b]Chaos Trials[/b], and tracks your fastest times
· [b]Bravery of Familiar Spirits[/b]: [b]new![/b] Now required to upgrade your [b]Animal Familiars[/b]
· [b]Arisen Troves[/b]: [b]new![/b] Makes [b]Infernal Troves[/b] sometimes appear in Surface Locations
· [b]Surge of Desecrating Pools[/b]: [b]new![/b] Makes [b]Pools of Purging[/b] appear between Underworld Regions
· [b]Frozen Lifespring[/b]: [b]new![/b] Makes a Fountain Chamber sometimes appear in the new Region
· Adjusted requirements and costs of several Incantations
· Melinoë and Hecate now will sometimes conclude Incantations in unison

[h1]Altar of Ashes[/h1]
· [b]The Sorceress[/b]: reworked — makes Omega moves faster; prior effect now on [b]Silver Wheel (Hecate)[/b]
· [b]The Swift Runner[/b]: no longer makes your Dash faster, since this effect now is innate
· [b]Death[/b]: added a new UI indicator for the effect
· [b]Strength[/b]: reworked; now provides a [i]global[/i] damage boost, if you have no Death Defiance effects
· Adjusted upgrade costs of various Cards
· Improved contextual hints for upgrading [b]Grasp[/b]
· Clarified descriptive text for various Cards

[h1]Keepsakes[/h1]
· Each of the two new allies you can meet has a unique Keepsake you can gain in the customary way
· [b]Silver Wheel (Hecate)[/b]: reworked — now slows everything around you while you channel Omega moves
· [b]Gold Purse (Charon)[/b]: now affected by Gold-boosting Boons such as [b]Affluence (Chaos)[/b]
· Improved feedback and fixes for when certain Keepsakes expire for the night
· Adjusted placements of some Keepsakes in the Display Case [i](to make room for the new ones!)[/i]
· Clarified descriptive text for several Keepsakes

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· Each of the two new allies you can meet has their own blessings to aid in your task
· [b]All Together (Hera)[/b]: renamed from [b]Elementary Particles[/b]; now her Legendary, no longer a Hestia Duo
📢 [b]Cherished Heirloom (Hera x Demeter)[/b]: now also improves your current Keepsake, not just later ones
· [b]Spiteful Strength (Hera x Hephaestus)[/b]: cut from game, though the effect can now be found in [b]Wells of Charon[/b] in the new item [b]Danaid Dagger[/b]
· [b]Brave Face (Hera x Hephaestus)[/b]: this is now a Duo and no longer offered by Hera alone
· [b]Incandescent Aura (Hera x Hestia)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Whenever you restore Magick, damage surrounding foes
· [b]Frosty Veneer[/b]: reduced effectiveness [i](the minimum damage you can take is now increased)[/i]
· [b]Ocean's Bounty (Poseidon)[/b]: Ash and Psyche rewards now are guaranteed; updated presentation
· [b]Plentiful Forage (Demeter)[/b]: reduced Life gain
· [b]Snow Queen (Demeter)[/b]: no longer blocks damage from [b]Vow of Time (Oath)[/b]
· [b]Love Handles (Aphrodite x Hephaestus)[/b]: raised effectiveness
· [b]Heart Breaker (Aphrodite)[/b]: [b]Heartthrobs[/b] now deal reduced damage and require more Magick to appear
· [b]Smithy Sprint (Hephaestus)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Stamp Rush (Hephaestus)[/b]: [b]new![/b] After you Dash, occasionally create a blast around a nearby foe
· [b]Mint Condition (Hephaestus)[/b]: reduced invulnerability duration
· [b]Grand Caldera (Hephaestus)[/b]: fixed Heroic Rarity, which previously was not stronger than Epic
· [b]Crispy Coating (Hestia)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...

notes.title: New Hades 2 patch preps for major update with balance tweaks and fixes
notes.content:
Hades 2 isn't even out yet, and it's already an incredibly solid roguelike adventure. Supergiant's work on the sequel is well underway, with preparations being made for the first major update to the game coming later this year. For now, the newest patch focuses on making changes to the balance of various weapons and boons, alongside remedying bugs that have been pointed out by early access testers so far.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Early Access Patch 4 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/34d111aa1e2b69286e80a373ee7af0681ab9bba6.png[/img]
This smaller patch addresses various issues we've observed since our previous patches, which we wanted to alleviate before our first [b]Major Update[/b] later this year. Thank you for your feedback and support!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [b]Sister Blades (Melinoë)[/b]: increased damage striking foes from behind

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· [b]Lightning Lance (Zeus)[/b]: improved targeting while using gamepad controls
· [b]Spirit Surge (Zeus)[/b]: reworked; now whenever you use magick, a surrounding foe is struck by lightning
· [b]Sworn Strike (Hera)[/b]: slightly reduced bonus from [b]Poms of Power[/b]
· [b]Engagement Ring (Hera)[/b]: reworked; inflicts Hitch on foes, and any slain in the circle deal area damage
· [b]Family Trade (Hera)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Rousing Reception (Hera)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Casts damage foes as they enter the Encounter, wherever they appear [i](this effect was previously innate to Engagement Ring)[/i]
· [b]Golden Rule (Hera X Poseidon)[/b]: now applies a multiplicative global damage bonus, rather than a flat bonus only to Attacks and Specials
· [b]Beach Ball (Poseidon x Apollo)[/b]: added greater damage and area scaling over a brief charge-up duration
· [b]Mint Condition (Hephaestus)[/b]: invulnerability effect now resets between Encounters in same Location

[h1]Daedalus Hammer Upgrades[/h1]
· [b]Mirrored Thrasher (Staff)[/b]: removed Life penalty; now requires Magick instead
· [b]Skulking Slice (Blades)[/b]: reduced bonus damage striking foes from behind
· [b]Escalating Ambush (Blades)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Wicked Onslaught (Blades)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Adds power to Attacks
· [b]Melting Shredder (Axe)[/b]: increased damage to Armor
· [b]Inverted Spark (Flames)[/b]: now also causes projectiles to linger for longer
· [b]Whirling Coil (Flames)[/b]: projectiles no longer spin in place; renamed from [b]Origin Coil[/b]
· [b]Crushing Comet (Flames)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Triple Comet (Flames)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Special fires more projectiles
· [b]Destructive Array (Skull)[/b]: now deals a percentage of your Attack damage whenever your Shells drop
· [b]Rocket Bombard (Skull)[/b]: increased damage

[h1]Hexes of Selene[/h1]
· [b]Phase Shift[/b]: rescaled some [b]Path of Stars[/b] upgrades
· [b]Lunar Ray[/b]: rescaled damage over a shorter duration

[h1]Foes & Encounters[/h1]
· [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler]: adjusted sequencing of some moves; now easier to strike from behind after certain moves
· [b]Headmistress Hecate[/b]: now easier to strike from behind after certain moves

[h1]Oath of the Unseen[/h1]
· [b]Vow of Haunting[/b]: Revenants can no longer spawn others; you now collect them from farther away
· Damage penalties from [b]Vow of Blood[/b] and [b]Vow of Suffering[/b] now are added, rather than multiplied

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
📢 Fixed several later narrative events related to [b]Nemesis[/b] and [b]Moros[/b] never playing
📢 Fixed interaction between [b]Witch's Staff (Momus)[/b] and [b]Mirrored Thrasher (Daedalus - Staff)[/b]
📢 Fixed visual shield from [b]The Lovers (Arcana)[/b] not appearing while using [b]Sister Blades (Artemis)[/b]
📢 Fixed some hit-stun effects applying unexpectedly during [b]Riposte[/b] from [b]Sister Blades (Artemis)[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Ionic Gain (Zeus)[/b] not working correctly while [spoiler]Icarus[/spoiler] is around
📢 Fixed [b]Glorious Disaster (Zeus x Apollo)[/b] using Magick without activating the bonus effect
📢 Fixed [b]Hail Storm (Zeus x Demeter)[/b] sometimes not working on [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed interaction between [b]Bridal Glow (Hera)[/b] and [b]Heavy Metal (Hephaestus)[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Golden Rule (Hera x Poseidon)[/b] not applying a global damage bonus as the description states
📢 Fixed [b]Hydraulic Might (Poseidon)[/b] unexpectedly granting invulnerability at the start of Encounters
📢 Fixed [b]Water Fitness (Poseidon)[/b] unexpectedly restoring Life whenever you gained Water essences
📢 Fixed [b]Freezer Burn (Demeter x Hestia)[/b] sometimes not working on [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed [spoiler]Icarus[/spoiler] Armor boosts not correctly adding to [b]Hephaestus[/b] Armor boosts
📢 Fixed [b]Burnt Offering (Hestia)[/b] sometimes selecting a different Boon to sacrifice if Rarified
📢 Fixed [b]Hard Target (Hermes)[/b] not affecting [b]Sea-Serpent[/b] shots and other splitting shots
📢 Fixed [b]Atrophic ([spoiler]Chaos[/spoiler]) [/b]sometimes displaying incorrect values
📢 Fixed [b]Aetheric Moonburst (Daedalus - Staff)[/b] not restoring Magick when your Magick is full
📢 Fixed [b]Inverted Spark (Daedalus - Flames)[/b] sometimes preventing Attacks from destroying urns
📢 Fixed interaction between [b]Phase Shift (Selene)[/b] and [b]Alacrity[/b] upgrade not resetting properly
📢 Fixed [b]Lunar Ray (Selene)[/b] firing indefinitely if you collected a reward while firing
📢 Fixed interaction between [b]Experimental Hammer ([spoiler]Icarus[/spoiler]) [/b]and [b]Full Salvo (Daedalus - Skull)[/b]
📢 Fixed several Keepsakes not correctly showing up as expired when switching between regions
📢 Fixed [b]Headmistress Hecate[/b] shadow copies being vulnerable to Aphrodite's [b]Charm[/b] Curse
📢 Fixed upgraded [b]Warding Circles[/b] in [b]Erebus[/b] sometimes recharging your Hex multiple times
📢 Fixed instances where time-slow effects could unexpectedly persist if quickly chained together
📢 Fixed Guardians appearing to restore Life after taking heavy damage from Hestia's [b]Scorch[/b] Curse
📢 Fixed cases where using [b]Change of Fate[/b] on a reward preview would not offer a different result
📢 Fixed [b]Witch of the Crossroads[/b] and [b]Natural Talent[/b] Prophecies not appearing as expected
📢 Fixed [b]Moon Beam (Selene)[/b] sometimes unexpectedly displaying as expired in Boon Info
📢 Fixed several Boons not appearing in their respective Olympians' Fated List Prophecies
📢 Fixed [b]Breath of Eros (Charon)[/b] not appearing in the [b]Valued Customer[/b] Fated List Prophecy
📢 Fixed a display issue in the [b]Fated List[/b] with the prompt to view more requirements
📢 Fixed Reset option in the [b]Oath of the Unseen[/b] not always resetting all Vows as expected
📢 Fixed instances where camera motion could push Melinoë offscreen in the [spoiler]Rift of Thessaly[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed an issue preventing the use of the [b]Book of Shadows[/b] while [spoiler]Icarus[/spoiler] is around
📢 Fixed occasional visual issues with special deliveries from [b]Shrines of Hermes[/b]
📢 Fixed several text and voiceover errors
📢 Fixed several rare crashes
📢 Other minor fixes

[h1]Quote of the Patch[/h1]
[i]'Ghost-evocation technology is first laid out in Homer's Odyssey and remains fairly conservative throughout ancient literature.[/i]

[b]~Magic, Witchcraft, and Ghosts in the Greek and Roman Worlds[/b] (D. Ogden)

notes.title: Early Access Patch 3 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/7989dd3530c1e74f64433a1bf00227bf0609e0df.png[/img]
This patch improves numerous Olympian Boons to further enhance core combat and related choices. It also adds new UI icons, Cauldron incantations, and more. Though we'll continue monitoring your feedback, we're now focusing on our first [b]Major Update[/b] slated for later this year. Thank you for playing!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
📢 Many [b]Duo Boons[/b] and some [b]Legendary Boons[/b] should be offered more frequently
📢 [b]Charon's Gold Rewards[/b] now include [b]Nightmare[/b] after a certain point
· Reworked [b]Gathering Tool[/b] upgrades; now let you find +1 Elemental Essence for your [b]Infusion Boons[/b]
· Entering [spoiler]Chaos[/spoiler] while in the [spoiler]Mourning Fields[/spoiler] no longer causes you to skip a Location in that region
· Slightly increased the minimum number of Boons and similar rewards you can find past [b]Erebus[/b]
· Warding Circles in [b]Erebus[/b] now stagger foes that touch them

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [b]Witch's Staff (Circe)[/b]: indirect damage from Omega Moves now contributes to activating Serenity
· [b]Sister Blades (Artemis)[/b]: you now are immune to hit-stun effects during Riposte
· [b]Umbral Flames (Eos)[/b]: improved Omega Attack tracking, though slightly increased Magick cost and reduced max damage from upgrade path; Attack sequence now continues after using it
· [b]Argent Skull (Persephone)[/b]: now any Cast damage [i](not just Omega Cast)[/i] extends your Omega Special

[h1]Altar of Ashes[/h1]
· Rearranged [b]Grasp[/b] costs and positions of several Cards; you may need to reset your Arcana loadout
· Swapped the names and theming of [b]The Moon[/b] and [b]Night[/b]
· [b]Death[/b]: reworked; Omega moves have a chance to deal Critical damage if the last one used was different
· [b]The Moon[/b]: now costs 0 Grasp but has an Awakening requirement to activate any surrounding Card
· [b]The Unseen[/b]: improved Magick restoration
· [b]Divinity[/b]: Awakening requirement expanded to include activating a column of Cards [i](not just a row)[/i]
· [b]Origination[/b]: now specifies that Curses from different Olympians are required; this is relevant with Demeter, whose Cyclone now is considered a Curse [i](along with her Freeze)[/i]

[h1]Crossroads Cauldron[/h1]
· [b]Temporal Fluctuation[/b]: [b]new![/b] Lets time-slow effects such as [b]Phase Shift (Selene)[/b] work vs. [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler]
· [b]Circles of the Moon[/b]: [b]new![/b] Activating Warding Circles in Erebus fully charges your Hex
· [b]Ashen Memories of Life[/b]: [b]new![/b] Whenever you claim rewards of Ash, slightly raise your Life limit
· [b]Psychic Slivers of Clarity[/b]: [b]new![/b] Whenever you claim rewards of Psyche, slightly raise your Magick limit
· [b]Bones of Burnished Bronze[/b]: [b]new![/b] Whenever you claim rewards of Bones, gain some Armor
· [b]Nectar of Godly Savor[/b]: [b]new![/b] Whenever you claim rewards of Nectar, gain +1 Lv. for a random Boon

[h1]Keepsakes[/h1]
· [b]White Antler (Artemis)[/b]: reworked; now provides Critical bonus for one Region, but reduces Life limit
📢 [b]Silken Sash (Arachne)[/b]: you no longer lose your Armor from this if you switch to a different Keepsake
📢 [b]Moon Beam (Selene)[/b]: now also causes [b]Selene[/b] or a [b]Path of Stars[/b] to be offered soon
📢 [b]Olympian Keepsakes[/b] are now even more likely to make their respective Olympian Boons appear

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
· [b]Heaven Strike (Zeus)[/b]: increased bonus from [b]Poms of Power[/b]

notes.title: Early Access Patch 2 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/5fe489c2dce3ebae7f1f51a6c5d2391ed91ccace.png[/img]
Among the improvements in this patch, look for many new UI icons as well as weapon-related balance changes aimed at enhancing core combat and related choices. Your feedback and volunteered gameplay data help inspire our changes, so thank you for playing! Stay tuned for Boon updates in our next patch.

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates changes inspired by community feedback!

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
· You now can encounter up to one additional Olympian each night [i](as in the previous game)[/i]
· You now are likely to find one more Boon or other major reward while in [b]Erebus[/b]
📢 Increased invulnerability duration after your [b]Death Defiance[/b] effects activate
📢 Improved rewards of [b]Ash[/b] and [b]Psyche[/b] can now be found in [spoiler]Oceanus[/spoiler] and the [spoiler]Rift of Thessaly[/spoiler]
📢 You now can press-and-hold to harvest repeatedly from [b]Crescent Pick[/b] Outcroppings
📢 [b]Toula[/b] should now stay closer to you in Encounters, especially in the [spoiler]Fields of Mourning[/spoiler]
📢 [spoiler]Nemesis[/spoiler] no longer offers [b]Death Defiance[/b] items if you do not need to refill the effect
· Reduced Gold cost of [b]Selene's Boon[/b] and [b]Path of Stars[/b] in [b]Charon's Shop[/b]
· Minor adjustments to the order in which Olympians may first appear early on
· Normalized chances of finding [b]Fishing Points[/b] in various regions

[h1]Nocturnal Arms & Abilities[/h1]
📢 [b]Witch's Staff[/b]: Special knocks foes away, but is slightly slower; Omega Special is faster
📢 [b]Sister Blades[/b]: Special staggers standard foes longer; Attack visual FX better match the hitbox
📢 [b]Umbral Flames[/b]: Attacks are stronger and faster; Omega Attack channels faster and uses less magick; Special gives a speed boost, but has reduced damage; Omega Special can be channeled while moving
📢 [b]Moonstone Axe[/b]: reworked Special provides a lingering barrier; Omega Attack channels slightly faster; Omega Special channels faster
📢 [b]Argent Skull[/b]: Omega Attack channels faster and hits a larger area

[h1]Aspects of the Nocturnal Arms[/h1]
· [b]Witch's Staff (Circe)[/b]: adjusted activation and duration of Serenity effect; Serenity now adds Omega bonus damage that scales with this Aspect's rank
· [b]Witch's Staff (Momus)[/b]: reworked; each of your Omega Moves automatically fires several times in succession from where you use them
📢 [b]Sister Blades (Artemis)[/b]: you will Block again if the effect recharges while you are channeling; Block now takes priority over Dodge and similar effects
· [b]Umbral Flames (Eos)[/b]: reworked; Omega Attack now fires a slow shot that occasionally creates damage blasts and also copies your Specials
· [b]Moonstone Axe (Melinoë)[/b]: reworked; now adds Power and Max Life
· [b]Moonstone Axe (Thanatos)[/b]: reworked; faster Attack adds Critical chance to Omega moves
· [b]Argent Skull (Medea)[/b]: improved hit detection on foes near impassable obstacles
· [b]Argent Skull (Persephone)[/b]: you now earn Glory much faster, but only by using your Omega Cast; improved control responsiveness during Omega Special

[h1]Keepsakes[/h1]
📢 [b]Moon Beam (Selene)[/b]: increased bonus to [b]Path of Stars[/b] upgrades

[h1]Daedalus Hammer Upgrades[/h1]
· [b]Marauder Wallop (Staff)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Rapid Thrasher (Staff)[/b]: [b]new![/b] All your Attacks become faster
· [b]Double Wallop (Staff)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Wicked Thrasher (Staff)[/b]: [b]new![/b] All your Attacks gain bonus Power
· [b]Double Cataclysm (Staff)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Mirrored Thrasher (Staff)[/b]: [b]new![/b] All your Attacks hit twice, but you take more damage
· [b]Rapid Moonshot (Staff)[/b]: also affects Omega Special
· [b]Dual Moonshot (Staff)[/b]: also affects Omega Special; reduced range; renamed from [b]Double Moonshot[/b]
· [b]Shimmering Moonshot (Staff)[/b]: also affects Omega Special
· [b]Aetheric Moonburst (Staff)[/b]: increased Magick restoration from Power Shots
· [b]Concentrated Flurry (Blades)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Melting Dart (Blades)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Special destroys a large percentage of a foe's Armor
· [b]Flick Knives (Blades)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Dash-Strike also fires several Special knives in a fan pattern
· [b]Rapid Onslaught (Blades)[/b]: reworked to also affect Omega Attack; renamed from [b]Marauder Slice[/b]
· [b]Hook Knives (Blades)[/b]: removed damage bonus; slightly reduced speed of knives returning to you
· [b]Furious Fire (Flames)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Mega Spark (Flames)[/b]: [b]new![/b] All your Attacks travel farther and deal more damage
· [b]Inverted Spark (Flames)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Dash to make shots from Attacks reverse direction and hit foes again
· [b]Leaden Spark (Flames)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Attacks knock foes away and have bonus Power
· [b]Sustained Spark (Flames)[/b]: also increases move speed, instead of reducing; formerly [b]Sustained Fire[/b]
· [b]Melting Coil (Flames)[/b]: no longer fires straight; also affects Omega Special; formerly [b]Melting Comet[/b]
· [b]Origin Coil (Flames)[/b]: also affects Special
· [b]Rapid Slash (Axe)[/b]: reworked to also affect Omega Attack; renamed from [b]Marauder Slash[/b]
· [b]Giga Cleaver (Axe)[/b]: removed two-stage channeling [i](it always double-fires but uses more Magick)[/i]
· [b]Dashing Heave (Axe)[/b]: removed damage bonus; instead, it now hits twice
· [b]Sidelong Crash (Skull)[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
· [b]Mega Driver (Skull)[/b]: [b]new![/b] Your Specials travel farther and deal more damage
· [b]Colossus Driver (Skull)[/b]: also affects Omega Special

[h1]Hexes of Selene[/h1]
· [b]Wolf Howl[/b]: reduced Magick-spend requirement
· [b]Twilight Curse[/b]: greatly reduced Magick-spend requirement; reduced foes afflicted; reduced cast time
· [b]Night Bloom[/b]: reduced Magick-spend requirement, effect duration, bonus damage, and cast time
· [b]Lunar Ray[/b]: greatly reduced Magick-spend requirement; reduced damage; reduced cast time
· [b]Moon Water[/b]: slightly increased Magick-spend requirement; slightly reduced healing
· [b]Dark Side[/b]: slightly increased Magick-spend requirement; slightly reduced cast time

[h1]Foes & Encounters[/h1]
📢 [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler]: various fixes and adjustments; there should be fewer cases where he's patently unfair
· [spoiler]Infernal Cerberus[/spoiler]: minor adjustments to some attack patterns in the first phase
📢 [spoiler]Eris[/spoiler]: grenade attacks no longer wildly bounce around
📢 [spoiler]Polyphemus[/spoiler]: reduced effectiveness of [spoiler]Mutant Sheep[/spoiler]
📢 [b]Goldwrath[/b]: reduced accuracy and tracking of beam attack
· [b]Queen Lamia[/b]: slightly increased Armor; increased speed; other minor changes
· [b]Reed-Stalker[/b]: increased projectile speed and target distance; reduced rotation speed
· [b]Mourner[/b]: slightly increased rotation speed; slightly increased speed while attacking
· [b]Lamia[/b]: slightly increased life and Elite armor
📢 [b]Dire Shambler[/b]: reduced tracking speed between attacks
📢 [b]Hippo[/b]: self-destruct area should more closely match the visuals

[h1]Level Design & Environments[/h1]
📢 [spoiler]Driftwood[/spoiler] resources are more common in the [spoiler]Rift of Thessaly[/spoiler] [i](a further increase since last patch)[/i]
📢 Burning Oil Slicks in the [spoiler]Rift of Thessaly[/spoiler] will extinguish after Encounters, though may be reignited
📢 Adjusted Oil Slicks in some locations in the [spoiler]Rift of Thessaly[/spoiler]
· Minor fixes to several locations

[h1]Fated List of Minor Prophecies[/h1]
· Clearing [b]Original Sins[/b] no longer requires choosing the very rare [b]Barren[/b] curse from [spoiler]Chaos[/spoiler]

[h1]Chaos Trials[/h1]
📢 [b]Trial of Heartache[/b]: reduced difficulty and adjusted based on Aspect changes
📢 [b]Trial of Haste[/b]: reduced difficulty and adjusted based on Aspect changes

[h1]Oath of the Unseen[/h1]
· [b]Vow of Forsaking[/b]: no longer helps ensure you quickly get Duo and Legendary Boons

[h1]Menus & UI[/h1]
· Added many new UI icons for [b]Keepsakes[/b], [b]Weapons[/b], [b]Well of Charon[/b] offerings, and more
📢 [b]Insight Into Offerings (Cauldron)[/b] now also lets you check each Olympian's list of offerings in the [b]Book of Shadows[/b] while choosing their Boons [i](or the equivalent with other characters)[/i]
· [/]With the prior change, adjusted default key binding for [b]Rarify[/b]; some custom bindings have been reset
📢 Added a warning when you are down to your last use of [b]Death Defiance[/b]
📢 Opening the [b]Book of Shadows[/b] should show entries for nearby characters more reliably
📢 Removed the Unused Grasp notification when exiting the [b]Altar of Ashes[/b] while at a high Grasp limit
· Updated [b]Pitch-Black Stone[/b] screen to use Aspect-specific icons
· Adjusted input action bar layout at the bottom of the Boon Screen and similar
· Added borders to icons for Selene Hexes on the [b]Gifts of the Moon[/b] screen
· Added informational pop-up when using [b]F10[/b] to report bugs
· Other minor changes

[h1]Art & Visual FX[/h1]
📢 Reduced some full-screen flashing or strobing, such as from time-slow effects

[h1]Music & SFX[/h1]
· Added SFX for when certain active abilities such as Serenity are ready to use
· Updated placeholder SFX for various [b]Keepsakes[/b]
· Updated SFX for projectile collisions with [b]Umbral Flames (Moros)[/b]

[h1]Voice & Narrative[/h1]
· Unique voice lines should play more reliably when certain incantations are revealed in the [b]Cauldron[/b]
· Added voice lines when using [b]Phase Shift (Selene)[/b] vs. [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler] [i](or trying to...)[/i]
· More voice lines should play when confiding in [b]Frinos[/b] in certain contexts

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
📢 While brooding over the family portrait in the Crossroads, you may now snap out of it sooner
📢 You now can fully control the game using keyboard only if you rebind Attack and Special
📢 All timers now pause while in the presence of [b]Charon[/b] 
📢 An [b]Anvil of Fates[/b] will no longer be offered in [spoiler]Tartarus[/spoiler] if you have not found a [b]Daedalus Hammer[/b]
📢 In the [spoiler]Hades[/spoiler] Flashback, adjusted timing of hint for players who don't realize they are in control
· Reduced requirements for the incantation [b]Power to Pause and Reflect[/b] to be revealed
· Melinoë now respawns in the center of her magick circle near her tent [i](she was a bit off before...)[/i]
· Improved compatibility with more types of controllers
· Updated text for various upgrades and abilities

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
· Fixed [b]Double Up (Poseidon)[/b] sometimes doubling Mystery Boons; clarified description
· Fixed [b]Nightmare[/b] resources dropping unexpectedly in [b]Chaos Trials[/b]
📢 Fixed Omega moves occasionally becoming unresponsive after being chomped on by [spoiler]Polyphemus[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed deadliest attack of [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler] occasionally hitting when Melinoë was in a supposedly safe point
📢 Fixed [b]Umbral Flames[/b] Attack preventing Magick regeneration before channeling Omega Attack
📢 Fixed [b]The Queen[/b] and [b]Judgment (Arcana)[/b] appearing active while no others Arcana are active
📢 Fixed [b]Hearth Gain (Hestia)[/b] no longer restoring Magick if chosen as a Sacrifice Boon
📢 Fixed certain later [b]Oath Testaments[/b] for the [b]Sister Blades[/b] sometimes not appearing as expected
📢 Fixed cases where you could go out of bounds using the [b]Argent Skull[/b] in the battle vs. [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed more cases of some visual effects vs. [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler] lingering between phases or after the fight
📢 Fixed [b]Toula[/b] unceremoniously vanishing after you vanquish [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed additional issues with [b]Sun Worshiper (Apollo)[/b]
📢 Fixed additional issues with [b]Dark Side (Selene)[/b]
📢 Fixed additional issues with [b]Twilight Curse (Selene)[/b]
📢 Fixed a visual issue where [spoiler]Headmistress Hecate[/spoiler] could appear to slide after snared by your Cast
📢 Fixed [b]Spark of Ixion (Charon)[/b] causing a [spoiler]Chaos Gate[/spoiler] to appear in [spoiler]Asphodel?[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed [b]Golden Boughs[/b] sometimes not marking all available rewards in the [spoiler]Fields of Mourning[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed several narrative events that could play out of sequence
📢 Fixed [b]Odysseus[/b] rather rudely walking away while in conversation with [b]Nemesis[/b]
📢 Fixed [spoiler]Heracles[/spoiler] sometimes leaping away [i]forever[/i]
📢 Fixed Melinoë's voice reverting during her return sequence despite certain [spoiler]Circe[/spoiler] enchantments
📢 Fixed incorrect [spoiler]Echo[/spoiler] portrait in the [b]Book of Shadows[/b]
📢 Fixed incorrect music playing in some [b]Chaos Trials[/b], or not playing as intended in some instances
📢 Fixed rare cases of a looping sound playing indefinitely
📢 Fixed a rare instance when objectives in the Training Grounds could overlap
📢 Fixed several minor issues on the Victory Screen that shows when you prevail
📢 Fixed additional miscellaneous issues when playing in ultrawide resolutions
📢 Fixed a rare crash in which the effect of [b]Winter Harvest (Demeter)[/b] could repeat [i]forever[/i]
📢 Fixed various other rare crashes
📢 Fixed several text errors
📢 Other minor fixes

[h1]Quote of the Patch[/h1]
[i]'Hecate was the Goddess of the Dark of the Moon, the black nights when the moon is hidden. She was associated with deeds of darkness, the Goddess of the Crossways, which were held to be ghostly places of evil magic.'[/i]

[b]~Mythology: Timeless Tales of Gods and Heroes[/b] (E. Hamilton)

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1 Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/01703bdd7b93bc5b51101cfa3fd98f8313c4e40b.png[/img]
Here's our first patch in [b]Early Access[/b]!! We're very grateful for all the feedback so far, which inspired this first set of targeted improvements and fixes. Next, we'll be working on a patch with balance changes and additional improvements based on what we've observed. Thank you for playing!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates a change inspired by community feedback! [i](Almost everything in this case...!)[/i]

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
📢 Your [b]Sprint [/b]is innately faster and turning is more responsive; re-scaled abilities that boost this
📢 You now can [b]Dash [/b]out of many attack recovery animations more reliably
📢 You now can gather from [i]any [/i]resource point once you have unlocked the corresponding [b]Gathering Tool[/b]; you now can [i]Prioritize [/i]any available Tool in the Training Grounds to make its resources appear as often as before, while resources for Tools you do [i]not [/i]Prioritize will appear far less often

[h1]Altar of Ashes[/h1]
📢 [b]The Swift Runner[/b]: now also makes your Dash immediate (note the faster speed means you are invulnerable for very slightly less time); re-scaled Sprint speed bonus since Sprint is innately faster now

[h1]Level Design & Environments[/h1]
📢 It is easier to Dash across chasms in [spoiler]Oceanus[/spoiler]
📢 [spoiler]Driftwood[/spoiler] resources are more common in the [spoiler]Rift of Thessaly[/spoiler]

[h1]Menus & UI[/h1]
📢 Using a [b]Well of Charon [/b]displays your current [b]Gold [/b]without the need to check your [b]Boon Info[/b]
📢 The [b]Grasp [/b]Upgrade Tutorial in the [b]Altar of Ashes [/b]will repeat if ignored
📢 Added [b]Patch Notes [/b]option to the Main Menu [i](where you can read this!)[/i]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]
📢 Early encounters with [spoiler]Eris[/spoiler] are less likely to occur; she also drops something of value...
📢 Related, if this already occurred, look for a one-time bonus in the [b]Crossroads [/b]while [spoiler]Eris[/spoiler] is present
📢 Entries in the [b]Book of Shadows [/b]are generally easier to reveal
📢 You can gift [spoiler]Echo[/spoiler] without having to wait around as long after conversing
📢 Adjusted [spoiler]Animal Familiar[/spoiler] upgrades invalidated by the [b]Gathering Tool [/b]changes above
📢 In the [spoiler]Hades[/spoiler] Flashback, a hint will eventually play for players who don't realize they are in control
📢 Improved mouse selection in various cases
📢 Improved support for some additional controllers
•  Abilities that boost Sprint speed display more-accurate numbers [i](generally lower than before)[/i]
•  Updates and fixes to translations in some languages

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
📢 Fixed several issues with [b]Dark Side (Selene)[/b]
📢 Fixed [b]Sun Worshiper (Apollo) [/b]sometimes preventing new foes from spawning
📢 Fixed [b]Fire Extinguisher (Hestia) [/b]not dealing damage as expected
📢 Fixed [b]Sister Blades Omega Attack [/b]not hitting [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler] reliably from certain angles
📢 Fixed [spoiler]Satyr Hoplites[/spoiler] retaining the ability to block while afflicted with [b]Twilight Curse (Selene)[/b]
📢 Fixed various cases of foes sometimes spawning out of bounds
📢 Fixed camera zoom-in getting stuck vs. [spoiler]Polyphemus[/spoiler] in certain situations
📢 Fixed cases where you could Dash out of bounds in the [b]Crossroads[/b]
📢 Fixed Fishing Pier events in the [b]Crossroads [/b]not passing Whiles like other similar events
📢 Fixed autolock not clearing as expected while using mouse controls
📢 Fixed keyboard inputs sometimes getting stuck unexpectedly
📢 Fixed several input issues switching from gamepad to mouse-and-keyboard controls
📢 Fixed several issues playing in ultrawide resolutions
📢 Fixed some visual effects vs. [spoiler]Chronos[/spoiler] lingering between phases or after the fight
📢 Fixed a Melinoë voice line repeating unexpectedly around the [spoiler]City of Ephyra Bat Cages[/spoiler]
📢 Fixed various rare crashes
📢 Fixed several text errors
📢 Other minor fixes

[h1]Quote of the Patch[/h1]
[i]'...now plain to the eye, now shadowy, now shining in the darkness—[/i]
[i]all this in unnerving attacks in the gloom of night.'[/i]

[b]~The Orphic Hymns, 71: To Melinoë [/b](Anonymous; A. Athanassakis translation)

notes.title: Early Access Update & First Patch Plan
notes.content:
Thanks so much to everyone who's taken the time to play [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] in Early Access so far! We've been delving into all your impressions and feedback, and we're very excited to move forward in this new phase of development. In this post, we wanted to share our short-term plans.

[h2]We're Focused on a Smooth Play Experience[/h2]
Following our launch, we've deployed several small hotfixes that alleviated rare crashes and progression bugs. We typically don't provide patch notes for small technical hotfixes such as this, though they help us make sure we're building on a solid foundation. We are continuing to watch for error reports closely.

[h2]We're Gathering Feedback and Data[/h2]
Impressions posted here on Steam, our official Discord, and beyond are letting us gauge how everyone's feeling about the game and how that aligns with our goals. With the help of our translators, we're getting feedback from players all over the world! We're also collecting anonymous gameplay data voluntarily submitted by players, which helps us identify opportunities to improve the balance of Boons, weapons, foes, and so on. This is an ongoing process that's just getting started.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/f6d71cae4f4ff215c582f52541f83ddc7e6db0f4.png[/img]
[h2]Our First Patch is In the Works![/h2]
Our first patch should be coming later this month, though note we don't have a more-specific timeline. With it, we're looking for improvements we can make in the near term, in a way that makes [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] better for everyone and come closer to realizing our goals. For example:

[list]
[*][b]Resource Gathering: [/b]We want [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] players to focus on goals that are important to them, though don't want resource gathering to feel too frustrating, such as if you didn't bring the right gathering tool along for the ride.

[*][b]Getting Around: [/b]It's important to us that Melinoë have her own distinct style, and for players to be able to navigate her battles and other interactions in a nimble, responsive, expressive way. We have ideas for how to improve her Dash and Sprint.
[/list]
Our first patch will likely have a few other enhancements and fixes, and we'll have comprehensive patch notes when the time comes. So stay tuned!

[h2]We're Considering Our First Balance Changes[/h2]
If you were with us for the Early Access development of the original game, you know we love making balance changes! We're always looking for opportunities to make the content and choices in the game as interesting as we can. However, we're still gathering feedback and data that helps inform the kind of changes we like to make, so don't expect too many such changes just yet.

[h2]Thank You For Your Support![/h2]
We will likely have at least one more patch after our first, to make additional improvements and fixes in the short term. From there, we will focus on the development of our first Major Update planned for some months from now, which will contain various new features and content.

Early Access has already been incredibly instructive to us about ways in which we might make [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] the best it can be. We really appreciate you playing and taking the time to share your impressions with us! [i]Death to Chronos![/i]

notes.title: HADES II Technical Test Update
notes.content:
[i]Update, April 26:[/i] Thank you very much for your patience as we conducted the [i][b]Hades II Technical Test[/b][/i]. The Test helped us identify and address a number of key technical issues we weren't able to find before, in preparation to launch [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] here in Early Access.

We plan to start winding down the Technical Test on Monday, April 29, after which point it will no longer be available in participants' Steam libraries. However, we plan to launch [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] in Early Access relatively soon after, so please stay tuned! We hope you share our excitement for Early Access, and really appreciate your support and encouragement during the Test!

* * *

[i]April 16:[/i] We're getting close to launching [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] in Early Access! As noted in our latest [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1145350]Development Update[/url], a key step prior to that is our [i][b]Hades II Technical Test[/b][/i], which we plan to begin shortly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/6c1aa7e05e09e223f2e6a323f32f26ca55bade75.png[/img]

[h2]About the Hades II Technical Test[/h2]
We're conducting the [i][b]Hades II Technical Test[/b][/i] prior to our Early Access launch to help us find and solve any technical issues we might have missed thus far, to ensure anyone who tries [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] in Early Access can have a smooth play experience from the start. The Technical Test contains much less content than what's in store for the Early Access launch, and may be available only to a relatively small subset of players who express interest in participating.

[h2]How to Sign Up[/h2]
We are using [b]Steam Playtest[/b] to run the [i][b]Hades II Technical Test[/b][/i]. If you'd like to be considered for participation, you can sign up right now simply by clicking '[b]Request Access[/b]' on our Steam page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145350/Hades_II/

[h2]Who Gets to Participate[/h2]
A subset of players who request access will be invited to participate via an email from Steam with download instructions. We expect to start with a small player population, then grow it over time. So, even if you aren't invited to the Technical Test right away, you may still be invited later. Our process boils down to: [i]invite some players, fix any problems they run into, invite more players, and so on.[/i] Once we're sufficiently confident that things are stable, we will wind down the Technical Test, then launch the game in Early Access relatively soon after.

As the purpose of the Technical Test is to test the game with a relatively small audience, we may not be able to honor individual requests to participate. We will do our best to conduct the Technical Test as expeditiously as possible, then launch in Early Access, at which point the game will be available for anyone to purchase and play.

[h2]Technical Test Duration[/h2]
The nature of the Test is such that we don't know exactly how long it will last, though our estimate is '[i]longer than a week, shorter than a month[/i]'. We likewise don't know exactly when we will launch [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] in Early Access, since that will depend on how long we end up running the Technical Test.

[h2]Technical Test System Requirements[/h2]
Here are the minimum system requirements for the Technical Test:

[b]OS:[/b] Windows 10 64-bit (or [b]Steam Deck[/b])
[b]Processor:[/b] Dual Core 2.4 Ghz
[b]Memory:[/b] 8GB RAM
[b]Graphics:[/b] GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R7 360, or Intel HD Graphics 630

[h2]Technical Test Contents[/h2]
The Technical Test contains the first major area of the game, and other early-game characters, systems, and content. (If you played the original game, imagine a version where you couldn't get past Tartarus even if you vanquished its guardian.) If you end up clearing the first major area a number of times, the game will gently suggest that you discontinue play, as Early Access shouldn't be far behind!

Note that due to structural differences with the Early Access version of the game, save data from the Technical Test will [i]not[/i] transfer.

[h2]How Technical Test Participants Can Help[/h2]
Just play! If you encounter crashes or other technical issues, the game will provide instruction on how to report those to us.

[h2]Closing Remarks[/h2]
Thank you for your interest in [i][b]Hades II[/b][/i] and this Technical Test! It's important to us to start our forthcoming Early Access with as few technical issues as possible, so that the focus can be on getting your feedback on the game itself. We're very excited to share that game with you soon, and appreciate your patience and support as we prepare!
